context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › HCP Planner overview
text:
## HCP Planner overview

When defining your ad strategy, it’s vital to craft a plan that meets your client’s requirements while achieving healthcare campaign goals and objectives. Healthcare Professional (HCP) media plans created in the Planner app give you powerful insights into your strategy’s potential reach and impressions once those parameters are layered onto your campaigns. You can pre-optimize your audience and targeting details to help ensure each campaign spends in full—all without allocating resources to test-and-learn budgets. This includes segmenting HCPs based on factors such as medical specialty, geographic location, and more; and determining budgets and targeting criteria for each campaign.

The plans you create will automatically sync with campaign management tools. This means you can easily transition from planning to execution once you gain client buy-in. Simply convert an HCP Planner plan into healthcare campaigns in one click, add your creatives, and launch your pre-optimized campaigns.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Eligibility requirements and pricing
text:
## Eligibility requirements and pricing

Healthcare advertisers are eligible to generate HCP plans in the Planner app at no additional cost.

Note that there is a cost associated with each data partner selection you make while creating in-plan audiences. However, their CPMs only apply when you convert the plan into an IO and campaigns, and those campaigns begin serving impressions against those audiences.

You can locate a data partner’s CPM in the **Data Cost** section. Refer to [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan) to get started, or continue reading for more information on HCP plans.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Plan inputs
text:
## Plan inputs

You’ll define the following required items for each plan, and apply targeting parameters across three optional categories, if desired.

| **Section** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Basic Details** | Required | Specify the plan’s name, time zone, date range, and [frequency cap](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10906959-optimization-delivery-overview#h_a623e383be) settings. |
| **Plan Settings** | Required | Choose either a [monetary budget or an impression budget](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8481053-budget-based-and-impression-based-insertion-order-io-overview) for the plan’s campaigns. |
| **User Types and Audience Methods** | Required | Select a user type (HCP, Nurse) and choose up to four Audience Methods for adding your target audience to the plan. |
| **Creative Types** | Required | Confirm whether the plan’s campaigns will target image, HTML, video, and/or audio creatives. All Creative Types are selected by default, and at least one is required per plan. |
| **Device Types** | Required | Select one or more device types including TV, tablet, desktop, or mobile. All Device Types are selected by default, and at least one is required per plan. |
| **Channel Types** | Required | Select one or more channels including app, web, connected TV (CTV), and over the top (OTT). All Channel Types are selected by default, and at least one is required per plan. |
| **Location** | Optional | Choose one or more states, cities, or ZIP codes. Note that Location targeting settings are available while completing the Filter Based and Upload NPI List. audience-creation workflows |
| **Inventory** | Optional | Choose Open Exchange inventory, or choose an existing [Open Exchange inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_64b8b6de94) or [Connected TV (CTV) inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_c7fa0236ff) that you previously created in the Inventory app. |
| **Split Strategy** | Required/Optional | Every plan’s campaigns are segmented by Creative Type (required), NPI Type (required), and (Data) Partner (optional) by default. If desired, you can also segment your plan’s campaigns by the Device Type and/or Audience Type dimensions. |

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Plan outputs › Campaigns
text:
### Campaigns

A single plan may contain up to 250 campaigns. Refer to the table below for a list of the elements that are generated for each campaign, and which ones you can update.

| **Campaign element** | **Is the element editable?** | **Impacted fields*** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Campaign Name** | Yes | - |
| **Data Partner** | No | - |
| **Creative Type** | No | - |
| **Start Date** | Yes | Individual campaign’s **Impressions** and **Budget** fields regenerate |
| **End Date** | Yes | Individual campaign’s **Impressions** and **Budget** fields regenerate |
| **Reach** | No | - |
| **Impressions** | Yes | Plan’s **Total Plan Budget** field regenerates |
| **Media CPM** | Yes | Individual campaign’s **Budget** field regenerates |
| **Data CPM** | No | - |
| **Budget %** | Yes | All campaigns’ **Budget %** fields regenerate. |
| **Budget** | Yes | Individual campaign’s **Impressions** field regenerates; plan’s **Total Plan Budget** field regenerates |

***Impacted fields:** Changing an editable campaign value impacts other fields, or in certain cases, the entire HCP plan. This column describes which values will change when you update an editable field in a generated plan.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Plan outputs › Forecasts
text:
### Forecasts

In addition to customized campaigns, HCP plans return forecasting metrics that help you evaluate the potential reach of your campaigns before launching them. You can review these estimates while you build the plan and after you create it, and at the plan level and individual campaign level.

> **Forecasting notice:** Provided forecasts represent estimates that are based on the last seven days of data across the IQM bid landscape. The bid landscape is variable based on changes in available impressions, market seasonality, and other dynamic factors.

| **Forecast metric or graph** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **Reach** | A metric representing the estimated number of unique NPIs that are available for targeting. |
| **Impressions** | A metric representing the estimated number of times the ad will be served to the audience. |
| **Total Plan Budget** | The estimated total dollar amount that the plan’s campaigns can spend, which is calculated by using a formula of (impressions/1,000)*CPM. This value is based on the plan’s **Incremental Reach**, which includes only unique NPIs from each selected data partner based on the priorities you assigned. The budget will be calculated considering the Reach and data cost (CPM) at the partner level. |
| **NPI Type** | An interactive graph illustrating the estimated total NPIs available for an audience when no additional targeting rules are added, and what percentage of those NPIs are HCPs or Nurses. |
| **Specialties** | An interactive graph illustrating the estimated total reachable NPIs by each selected specialty. |
| **Accounts** | An interactive graph illustrating the estimated total reachable NPIs by each selected account type. |
| **Device Type** | An interactive graph illustrating the estimated percentage of impressions that will come from each device that the plan’s campaigns will target. |
| **Channel Type** | An interactive graph illustrating the estimated percentage of impressions that will come from each channel that the plan’s campaigns will target. |
| **Creative Type** | An interactive graph illustrating how different bid prices (CPM) might impact the potential number of impressions that you can win. This data is segmented based on the creative formats that you choose for the plan. |

Refer to Key terms and concepts for more information on how your targeting parameters can impact a campaign’s ability to scale and spend.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Plan statuses
text:
## Plan statuses

You can review a proposal’s current status on the **Plans** page of the Planner app. Refer to [Manage a plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan#h_f75eb0a053) for more information on how to access this page.

| **Status** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| **Draft** | The plan creation process is underway and not yet finalized. In other words, you started building an HCP plan, but you haven’t selected **Create Plan** to begin processing it. |
| **Ready** | The plan is generated, and its forecasting metrics and campaigns are ready for your review. You can now select **Create IO** to activate the plan. |
| **Processing** | You selected **Create IO** to activate the plan, and we’re creating your plan’s audiences, campaigns, IO, and other details. |
| **Failed** | You attempted to **Create IO**, but we were unable to successfully create your plan’s campaigns. Refer to [Troubleshoot an HCP Planner plan or campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238998-troubleshoot-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan-or-campaign#h_72bc5eb24a) for support. |
| **IO Created** | You selected **Create IO**, and the plan’s insertion order (IO) and campaigns were created. Now you can manage and launch them. |

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › IQM Universe
text:
### IQM Universe

The IQM universe refers to the total targetable audience that you can reach when you use the IQM platform to buy digital ad inventory. This universe changes based on your campaigns’ targeting criteria, and narrows each time you layer on additional targets and blocks. The addressable audience you’re left with after you apply this criteria is represented by your HCP plan’s targeted reach and impressions.

Forecasting metrics provide a sense of scale to help you determine whether you have the right strategies in place to spend your budget in full and achieve campaign objectives. If an HCP plan’s scale isn’t what you were anticipating, or if potential spend is less than your actual budget, then you have the opportunity to make adjustments to your plan and its strategies before you launch a live campaign.

Adjust your targeting criteria, as needed, to reach more of the IQM universe and achieve scale. If the targets you applied are nonnegotiable, consider thinking about the strategies you may need to add to your campaigns to fulfill your budget.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience Methods
text:
### Audience Methods

When you create a new HCP plan, you’ll choose up to three methods for adding target users to the plan’s campaigns: **Filter Based**, **Upload NPI List**, **Account Based**, and/or **Existing Audience**.

The **Filter Based** method includes using in-plan filters to create a new, custom audience based on US NPI data.

The **Upload NPI List** method includes bringing your own CSV file that contains a list of NPIs, and uploading it to create an audience.

The **Account Based** method includes using account-based attributes such as health systems, specialty practices, and NPI reach to create an audience.

The **Existing Audience** method includes selecting one or more audience types (**Matched**, **Segmented**, **Geofarmed**, **Contextual**, **Account Based**) and choosing one or more existing NPI-based audiences. These audiences are ones that you previously created in the Audiences app.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience Methods › Number of audiences created
text:
#### Number of audiences created

The number of audiences that are created per HCP plan depends on how many Audience Methods you choose, how many sub-types you select (e.g., HCP and Nurse), and how many data partners you select. Refer to the graphic above for an example of how the number of audiences is calculated based on these selections.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience types
text:
### Audience types

When you create an HCP plan and choose the **Existing Audience** Audience Method, you can add **Matched**, **Segmented**, **Geofarmed**, **Contextual**, and/or **Account Based** that you previously created in the Audiences app.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience types › Matched
text:
#### Matched

Matched audiences help ensure maximum unique reach to the healthcare professionals who move the needle for your healthcare brand.

HCP Matched audiences and Nurse Matched audiences deliver industry-leading NPI match rates to reach your campaign’s most relevant healthcare professionals. We directly ingest NPI numbers from leading industry sources, which power our identity graph with over 80% coverage of the HCP universe and result in maximum unique campaign reach.

Review [Matched audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11535636-matched-audience-overview#h_4fdefdc6d3) for more information, and refer to [Create an HCP or Nurse Matched audience (Healthcare)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11748442-create-or-manage-a-matched-audience#h_ea91f22ed0) to upload your NPI list in the Audiences app for audience matching.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience types › Segmented
text:
#### Segmented

Healthcare advertisers can create Segmented audiences for precise outreach to healthcare professionals across a number of audience categories. These segments vary by data provider and include NPI-based targeting.

Targeting strategies for Healthcare campaigns can be especially challenging as certain industry professionals don’t have NPI numbers associated with them. For example, you may want to reach nurses who play a major role in educating patients about their treatments and medications. In these instances, you can target nurse audience segments powered by Data360 to reach these healthcare professionals by specialty rather than NPI number. These segments span specialty categories including Diagnosis, Diagnosis Test, Imaging Test, Lab Test, Prescription, Procedure, and Treatment.

Review [Segmented audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_cde05c8585) for more information, and refer to [Create or manage a Segmented audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11749120-create-or-manage-a-segmented-audience) to create a new audience in the Audiences app based on user attributes.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience types › Geofarmed
text:
#### Geofarmed

Geofarmed audiences help ensure maximum unique reach to healthcare professionals (HCPs) and nurses based on their proximity to a set of physical locations. These locations may include, for example, hospitals, clinics, and healthcare events that move the needle for your brand. You’ll leverage our in-house and integrated data sources to compliantly extract the precise device IDs, location details, and NPI data needed to reach high-value healthcare professionals across their connected devices.

Review [Geofarmed audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6871135-geofarmed-audience-overview) for more information, and refer to [Create or manage a Geofarmed audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6871106-create-or-manage-a-geofarmed-audience) to create a new audience in the Audiences app based on users’ proximity to points of interest.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience types › Contextual
text:
#### Contextual

Contextual audiences help ensure maximum unique reach to HCPs and nurses based on their browsing behaviors. You indicate a list of relevant keywords and/or URLs and a timeframe. We add a user to the Contextual audience when they visit sites that feature those keywords or URLs, browse them during the time period you select, and meet any other parameters that you specify during audience setup. You can target the Contextual audience to advertise to that group of users across the open internet.

Review [Contextual audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/6972375-contextual-audience-overview) for more information, and refer to [Create or manage a Contextual audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/7018329-create-or-manage-a-contextual-audience) to create a new audience in the Audiences app.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience types › Account Based Marketing (ABM)
text:
#### Account Based Marketing (ABM)

Healthcare advertisers can create Account Based audiences, or ABM audiences, to maximize relevance, engagement, and value. These audiences leverage comprehensive hospital data from providers such as HealthLink Dimensions (HLD) or RevOptimal to pass personalized messages to healthcare professionals at scale, and with a privacy-safe approach.

With ABM audiences, you can craft highly specific healthcare audiences using custom and pre-defined segments based on account-based attributes such as health systems, specialty practices, and NPI reach.

Review [Account Based Marketing (ABM) audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10560051-account-based-marketing-abm-audience-overview) for more information, and refer to [Create or manage an Account Based Marketing (ABM) audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10560205-create-or-manage-an-account-based-marketing-abm-audience) to craft your audience in the Audiences app based on account-based attributes.

context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts
text:
### Audience relationships

An HCP plan applies an “OR” relationship to each audience type and individual audience. This means that your campaign will target a user if they’re included in any of the targeted audiences, as long as all other campaign targeting criteria are met.

### Data partner selection

When you select the Filter Based, Upload NPI List, or Account Based audience creation methods, we’ll prompt you to select one or more data partners for audience matching. You can review key information by partner to help inform what makes the most sense for a given plan.

| **Metric** | **Description** | **Available when one partner is selected** | **Available when multiple partners are selected** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Reach*** | The maximum number of users that you can reach by targeting the audience. | Yes | Yes |
| **Incremental Reach** | The maximum number of unique users that the selected data partner can reach based on the priorities you assigned (see: Incremental Reach and Priority). | Yes | Yes |
| **Priority** | The rank assigned to each selected data partner, determining the order in which audiences are deduplicated to determine Incremental Reach (see: Incremental Reach and Priority). | Yes | Yes |
| **Coverage** | The approximate proportion of the audience that the selected data partner can effectively reach. | Yes | Yes |
| **Coverage*** | The approximate percentage of coverage overlap between the selected data partners. | No | Yes |
| **Overlap*** | The approximate percentage of matched-NPI overlap between the selected data partners. | No | Yes |
| **Match Rate** | The percentage of users whose digital identities can be correlated to the NPI identifiers that you included in your source file(s). For reference, the average rate on the IQM platform is 80%. | Yes (NPI List Upload) | Yes (NPI List Upload) |
| **CPM** | The cost to display your ad 1,000 times to the audience provided by the selected data partner. | Yes | Yes |
| **Est. Budget** | The estimated total dollar amount that the plan’s audience(s) can spend, which is calculated by using the following formula: (reach/1,000)*CPM. | Yes | Yes |

***The Reach, Coverage, and Overlap metrics featured *above* the Partner Selection table is calculated based on the data partner(s) you selected.

The HCP plan will generate a separate audience for each partner selection.

section_path: Data partner selection - Incremental Reach and Priority
context_header: Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Data partner selection › Data partner selection - Incremental Reach and Priority
text:
#### Data partner selection - Incremental Reach and Priority

> **Minimum reach requirements:** You can select any data partners with a Reach or Incremental Reach of 10 or higher per NPI type (HCP, Nurse). For example, a Priority 1 data partner's Reach must equal or exceed 10, and Priority 2 and Priority 3 data partners’ Incremental Reach reach equal or exceed 10.

Each audience contains only unique (incremental) NPIs assigned to a given data partner. The deduplication process is completed based on the priority order that you select.

For example, a plan’s **Data Partner** breakout includes the details pictured above. The advertiser assigns **Priority 1** to the **HLD** partner. This data partner’s **Incremental Reach** (470K) matches its **Reach** (470K) because it’s the top-priority partner.

The advertiser assigns **Priority 2** to the **Data360** partner. In this example, 461K users overlap with the **Reach** of the **Priority 1 HLD** partner. This overlapping data is removed from the audience that will be created from the **Priority 2** partner. In other words, **Data 360**’s **Incremental Reach** will equal 15K (476K **Reach** - 461K **Overlap** = 15K **Incremental** **Reach**).

This deduplication process will continue in order of assigned **Priority** for each selected partner.

text:
#### Filter Based

#### Upload NPI List

The Upload NPI List Audience Method includes bringing your own file that contains a list of NPIs, and uploading it to create a new audience.

1. Download the provided sample file to help ensure your NPI file adheres to content and formatting guidelines.
2. Add your CSV or XLSX file containing the NPI list.
   1. To upload the list from your computer’s local files, select **Upload File** and choose the desired file.
   2. To drag-and-drop the list, open your computer’s local files, choose the file, and drag your cursor from the file to the **or Drag & Drop** portion of the plan.
   3. To upload the list from an external file-storage service such as Google Drive or a Dropbox account, select the corresponding company’s icon. You’ll be prompted to log in, accept any applicable privacy settings, and select the file from the online drive.
3. Follow the steps outlined in these sections to complete these required portions and finish creating your audiences:
   1. Data Partner (required)
   2. Specialties (optional)
   3. Location (optional)
4. Click **Next**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Account Based
text:
### Account Based

The Account Based Audience Method includes using account-based attributes such as health systems, specialty practices, and NPI reach to create an audience.

1. Follow the steps outlined in these sections to complete these required portions and finish creating your Account Based audiences:
   1. Account Type
   2. Data Partner
   3. Health Systems (optional)
   4. Specialties (optional)
   5. Location (optional)
   6. Title (optional)
2. Select **Next**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Account Based › Existing Audience
text:
#### Existing Audience

The Existing Audience method includes selecting one or more audience types (Matched, Segmented, Geofarmed, Contextual, Account Based) and choosing one or more existing NPI-based audiences. These audiences are ones that you previously created in the Audiences app.

1. Choose at least one, and up to five, audience types.
   1. Refer to [Key terms and concepts: Audience types](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_a24687301b) for more information on each audience type.
2. Select **Select Audiences**. This will open the **Select Existing Audience** pop-up window.
3. Select the check box(es) next to the audience(s) that you’d like to add to the plan.
   1. If desired, filter the listed audiences by status, data partner, and/or type.
   2. Up to 250 audiences are supported per plan.
4. Click **Select** to apply your selections to the plan.
5. Click **Next** to configure additional targeting settings for the plan.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Health Systems (Optional*)
text:
### Health Systems (Optional*)

> **Health Systems selection notice:** You have the option to choose one or more health systems if the plan’s [Audience Method](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_811e100a2b) is **Account Based**. The 50 health systems with the highest unique NPI counts are selected by default if no individual selections are made. Note that, if a plan’s Audience Method is **Filter Audience**, **Upload NPI List**, and/or **Existing Audience**, the plan-creation form will not include this section.

Follow these steps to add health systems to an audience:

1. Expand the **Health Systems** section.
2. Open the **Health Systems** menu to review and select the desired health systems.
3. If desired, select **Reset** to clear your health system selections.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Specialties (Required*)
text:
### Specialties (Required*)

> **Specialties selection notice:** You have the option to choose one or more specialties if the plan’s [Audience Method](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_811e100a2b) is **Filter Audience**, **Account Based**, and/or **Upload NPI List**. All specialties are selected by default if no individual selections are made. Note that, if a plan’s Audience Method is **Existing Audience**, the plan-creation form will not include this section.

Follow these steps to add specialties to an audience:

1. Expand the **Specialties** section.
2. Select the **Specialties** menu. This will open the **Specialties** pop-up window.
3. Open the **Select Specialties** menu, and search and select the desired items.
4. Click **Submit**.
5. If desired, select **Reset** to clear your specialty selections.
6. Select **Next**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Account (Required*)
text:
### Account (Required*)

> **Account selection notice:** The **Account** section is required only when the plan’s [Audience Method](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_811e100a2b) is **Account Based.** If its Audience Method is **Upload NPI List**, **Filter Based**, and/or **Existing Audience**, the plan-creation form will not include this section.

Follow these steps to add accounts to an audience:

1. Expand the **Account** section.
2. Select the **Account** menu. This will open the **Account** pop-up window.
3. Open the **Select Accounts** menu, and search and select the desired items.
4. Click **Submit**.
5. If desired, select **Reset** to clear your account selections.
6. Select **Next**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Data Partner (Required*)
text:
### Data Partner (Required*)

> **Data Partner selection notice:** You’ll be prompted to choose one or more data partners if the plan’s [Audience Method](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_811e100a2b) is **Filter Audience**, **Account Based**, and/or **Upload NPI List**. If its Audience Method is **Existing Audience**, the existing audiences you add to the plan will feature the same data partners that you chose when you initially set up those audiences in the Audiences app. These selections can’t be altered.

Follow these steps to choose which data provider(s) will provide matching data for the plan’s NPI-based audience(s):

1. Review each partner’s **Reach**, **CPM**, and **Est. Budget** details.
   1. Audiences created through the **Upload NPI List** option will also include **Match Rate** details, and those created through the **Filter Audience** option will also include **Coverage** details.
   2. Refer to [Key terms and concepts: Data partner selection](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_3ab1401aa8) for more information on these metrics and how they’re calculated.
2. Select the checkbox(es) next to your preferred data partner(s).
   1. Any partner with a **Reach** and **Incremental Reach** of 10 or greater can be selected.
   2. You must select **HLD** or **RevOptimal** as one of your partner selections if the plan includes an **Account Based** audience type.
3. If you selected more than one partner, review additional insights such as cumulative **Coverage** and **Reach by Partner**, as well as the data **Overlap** percentage.
4. If desired, change the default **Priority** settings of the selected partners.
   1. Refer to [Key terms and concepts: Data partner selection](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_3ab1401aa8) for more information on how priority settings impact **Incremental Reach** calculations.
5. Review **Incremental Reach** details by data partner.
6. Check the **Audience Summary** table for more details on the audiences that are eligible for creation based on your partner selections and their incremental reach by NPI type.
7. Select **Next**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Location (Optional)
text:
### Location (Optional)

> **Location targeting notice:** If the plan’s [Audience Method](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_811e100a2b) is **Upload NPI List, Filter Based,** and/or **Account Based**, you have the option to add Location targeting during the audience creation process. Note that plans created from the HCP Planner tool apply an “OR” relationship to your location targeting settings. This means that your campaign will target a user if they’re located in any of the targeted locations.

HCP Planner plans support location targeting within the United States. Follow these steps to add location-targeting rules to a plan:

1. Expand the **Location** section.
2. Click **+ Add locations**. This will open the **Location** pop-up window.
3. Select the **Search Locations** field.
4. Type or browse and select the desired location(s) by **State** or **City**.
   1. Filter the results by either of these categories, if desired.
5. Select the **Zip Codes** tab to search and select locations by ZIP code, if desired.
6. Review your selections in the **Targeted Locations** panel.
7. Click **Submit**.
8. Select **Next**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Title (Optional*)
text:
### Title (Optional*)

> **Title selection notice:** You have the option to choose one or more titles if the plan’s [Audience Method](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_811e100a2b) is **Account Based**. All titles are selected by default if no individual selections are made. Note that, if a plan’s Audience Method is **Filter Audience**, **Upload NPI List**, and/or **Existing Audience**, the plan-creation form will not include this section.

Follow these steps to add titles to an audience:

1. Expand the **Titles** section.
2. Open the **Title** menu to review and select the desired titles.
3. If desired, select **Reset** to clear your title selections.
4. Click **Next**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan
text:
### Device Types (Required)

> **Enable the TV device type:** You must select both **Video** and **TV Ad-Buying** in the **Creative Type** section to enable the **TV** option in the **Device Types** section. Refer to Creative Type (Required) for more details.

In the plan’s **Device Types** section, choose up to four devices that the plan’s campaigns should target. All are selected by default, and at least one is required.

### Creative Type (Required)

In the plan’s **Creative Types** section, choose up to five creative formats. All are selected by default, and at least one is required.

If you plan to run on connected TV (CTV) or over-the-top (OTT) devices, select both the **Video** tile and **TV-Ad Buying toggle**.

Review [Creative ad specs and requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/7019246-creative-ad-specs-and-requirements) to ensure that the creative(s) you plan to target will match the creative type(s) you select in this plan.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan
text:
### Channel Type (Required)

In the **Channel Types** section, choose up to four channels that the plan’s campaigns should target. All are selected by default, and at least one is required.

Note that the connected TV (CTV) or over-the-top (OTT) channels are only selectable when both the **Video** tile and **TV-Ad Buying toggle** are selected in the **Creative Type**section.

### Select Inventory (Optional)

If desired, you can use the **Select Inventory** section to target Open Exchange inventory and/or inventory groups:

- **Open Exchange:** Public inventory sources made available via real-time bidding auctions. This option includes targeting individual IAB categories and/or exchanges.
- **Inventory groups:** Inventory that you previously bundled in the Inventory app. Note that only Open Exchange and Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups are supported in HCP Planner proposals.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Select Inventory (Optional)
text:
#### Select Open Exchange inventory

Follow these steps to add Open Exchange inventory to a plan:

1. Expand the **Inventory** section.
2. Select **Open Exchange**.
3. To target the IAB Tech Lab’s page content categories, open the **IAB Categories** menu and select the desired categories.
4. To target specific ad exchanges, open the **Exchanges** menu and select the desired exchanges.

#### Select inventory groups

> **Inventory group notice:** You’ll need to create an inventory group in the Inventory app before you can add it to your proposal. Follow the steps outlined in [Create or manage an inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9616211-create-or-manage-an-inventory-group) to create an Open Exchange or Connected TV (CTV) inventory group in the Inventory app. Note that Open Exchange and CTV inventory groups created purely for blocking and groups with zero or unknown Reach aren’t eligible. Private Marketplace (PMP), Programmatic Guaranteed (PG), and Contextual inventory groups also aren’t eligible at any time.

Follow these steps to add existing Open Exchange or Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups to a plan:

1. Locate the **Select Inventory** section.
2. Select **Inventory Groups**.
3. Search or browse the list of Open Exchange and Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups.
4. If desired, filter the groups by group type.
5. Review key details about each inventory group:
   1. **Icon:** A circle icon next to the group name represents that the group is an Open Exchange inventory group, while the internet-connected TV icon represents that it’s a CTV inventory group.
   2. **Creative Type:** All supported creative format types are listed next to each inventory group’s name.
   3. **Count:** The total number of ad placements (**Inventories** or **Apps**) that match the search criteria you applied when you created the inventory group.
   4. **Device Breakdown:** The breakout of devices for each inventory group.
6. Click the checkbox(es) next to the inventory group(s) you wish to target.
7. Click **Next**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Split Strategy (Optional)
text:
### Split Strategy (Optional)

> **Maximum campaign limit notice:** While a plan’s **Split Strategy** allows you to create more precise campaigns, too many selections may cause you to exceed the plan’s maximum limit of 250 campaigns. If you receive an error related to exceeding 250 campaigns, change your **Split Strategy** selections to stay within the maximum campaign limit.

All plans’ campaigns are split by Creative Type (required), NPI Type (required) and (Data) Partner (optional) by default. If desired, you can also segment your plan’s campaigns by the Device Type and/or Audience Type dimensions.

Follow these steps to define a Split Strategy for this plan:

1. Expand the **Split Strategy** section.
2. Click the checkbox next to a targeting dimension to segment your campaigns by that dimension.
3. Open any drop-down menus that appear below a dimension category to make your campaigns even more targeted, if desired.
   1. For example, if you selected the **TV** and **Tablet** options in the **Device Types** section, you can use the **Split by Device Type** menu to segment campaigns by **TV** or **Tablet** devices.
4. Click **Update**.
5. Review the campaigns that your plan will include.
   1. The more detailed you make your Split Strategy selections, the more campaigns will be included in your plan.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
section_path: Save As Draft, Create IO, or Create Plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Create a plan › Save As Draft, Create IO, or Create Plan
text:
### Save As Draft, Create IO, or Create Plan

Select **Save As Draft** at any time to save your progress. Refer to Manage a plan for steps on how to access and update an existing plan draft.

When you reach and complete the **6 out of 6 steps** page, two additional options will appear: **Create Plan** and **Create IO**.

Select **Create Plan** to signal the platform to start processing the plan and its strategies. Once that process is complete and the plan features a **Ready** status, you can click **Create IO** to convert the plan into an insertion order (IO) and campaigns.

Review [Plan statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_831c43a04f) for more information on each status.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan
text:
## Manage a plan

> **Plan management notice:** Applying changes to an existing plan or its campaigns will impact forecasted figures such as reach and impressions. We recommend selecting **Refresh** near any forecasting metrics after you apply each change. The result will give you a better understanding of how any updates may update your plan’s ability to scale and perform.

Review and manage in-progress and generated plans from the Planner app:

- Review a plan
- Edit a plan
- Download a plan
- Duplicate a plan
- Delete a plan
- Edit a plan’s campaigns
- Delete a plan's campaigns

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan
text:
### Review a plan

Follow these steps to review an existing plan in the Planner app:

1. Select **HCP**.
2. Search by a proposal element (**ID**, **Name**, **Created By**) or date range, or filter by the plan’s status status, to limit which proposals will display on the page.
3. Click the plan’s name to open and review it.

### Edit a plan

You can apply changes to plans that feature a **Draft**, **Ready**, or **Failed** status. Follow these steps to edit a plan:

1. Select **HCP**.
2. Search by a proposal element (**ID**, **Name**, **Created By**) or date range, or filter by the plan’s status status, to limit which proposals will display on the page.
3. Select the checkbox next to the plan you’d like to edit.
4. Click **Edit**. This will open the plan in the Planner app.
5. Follow the steps outlined in Create a plan to edit the desired fields.

The updated plan will revert to the **Processing** stage.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan › Duplicate a plan
text:
### Duplicate a plan

You can duplicate plans that feature a **Draft**, **Ready**, **Processing**, **IO Created**, or **Failed** status.

Follow these steps to duplicate a plan:

1. Select **HCP**.
2. Search by a proposal element (**ID**, **Name**, **Created By**) or date range, or filter by the plan’s status status, to limit which proposals will display on the page.
3. Select the checkbox next to the plan you’d like to duplicate.
4. Click **Duplicate**. This will open the **Duplicate Plan** pop-up window.
5. Type a name into the **Plan Name** field.
   1. Choose a unique name to differentiate this plan from others that you may create.
   2. By default, the plan name will feature “Copy of” followed by the name of the plan you duplicated.
6. Select the plan’s **Timezone**.
7. Use the **Start Date** and **End Date** fields to select a date range for the plan.
8. Click **Duplicate**.

The duplicated plan will feature a **Draft** status. Refer to Edit a plan to apply any changes and generate the plan.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan
text:
### Delete a plan

> **Plan deletion notice:** Deleted plans are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent.

You can delete **Draft**, **Ready**, or **Failed** plans individually or in bulk.

Follow these steps to delete a plan:

1. Select **HCP**.
2. Search by a proposal element (**ID**, **Name**, **Created By**) or date range, or filter by the plan’s status status, to limit which proposals will display on the page.
3. Select the checkbox(es) next to the plan(s) you’d like to delete.
4. Click **Delete**.

### Download a plan

Follow these steps to download a plan featuring a **Ready**, **Processing**, **IO Created**, or **Failed** status.

1. Select **HCP**.
2. Search by a proposal element (**ID**, **Name**, **Created By**) or date range, or filter by the plan’s status status, to limit which proposals will display on the page.
3. Select the download icon in the desired plan’s **Actions** column.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan’s campaigns
text:
## Manage a plan’s campaigns

> **Campaign editing notice:** Changing an editable campaign value impacts other fields or, in certain cases, the entire plan. Refer to [Plan outputs: Campaigns](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_f9bf880572) for a list of the elements that are generated for each campaign, which ones you can update, and which fields may be impacted by those updates.

When you reach the **4 out of 4 Steps** page of the plan, you’ll have a chance to review each of the campaigns included in the plan. This includes details such as each campaign’s projected **Reach** and **Impressions**, **Budget** and **Budget %**, and more.

You can change certain campaign values–such as campaign Start Dates and End Dates–and remove campaigns from a plan before you activate it.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
section_path: Set a campaign’s Start Date or End Date
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan’s campaigns › Edit a plan’s campaigns › Set a campaign’s Start Date or End Date
text:
#### Set a campaign’s Start Date or End Date

You can change Start Dates or End Dates one by one or in bulk. Follow these steps to change one or more campaigns’ Start Dates or End Dates:

1. Locate the **Campaigns** section of the plan’s **6 out of 6 Steps** page.
2. Select the checkbox(es) next to the campaigns you’d like to update.
3. Click **Set Start Date** or **Set End Date**. Depending on your selection, this will open the **Set Start Date** or **Set End Date** pop-up window.
4. Use the **Start Date** or **End Date** field to choose the new value.
   1. The date you choose must fall within the date range you specified in the **Plan Summary**.
5. Click **Set** to apply the new Start Date or End Date to the selected campaign(s).

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan’s campaigns › Edit a plan’s campaigns › Edit another campaign value
text:
#### Edit another campaign value

You can edit certain campaign values individually. Refer to [Plan outputs: Campaigns](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_f9bf880572) for a full list of values you can edit prior to creating the plan, and follow these steps to apply your desired changes:

1. Locate the **Campaigns** section of your in-progress plan’s **6 out of 6 Steps** page.
2. Click the cell you’d like to update.
   1. Editable cells feature a dashed border, while uneditable cells feature a solid border.
3. Enter the desired characters or values directly into the selected cell.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan’s campaigns › Edit a plan’s campaigns › Edit the Total Plan Budget
text:
#### Edit the Total Plan Budget

> **Total Plan Budget adjustment notice: Total Plan Budget adjustment notice:** The **Total Plan Budget** is the estimated total dollar amount, or estimated total impressions, that the plan’s campaigns can spend or serve. This value is based on the plan’s **Incremental Reach**, which includes only unique NPIs from each selected data partner based on the [priorities](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_3ab1401aa8) you assigned. While you can update this value manually, note that doing so will apply changes to the plan’s individual campaigns. Refer to [Plan outputs: Campaigns](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_f9bf880572) for more information.

Follow these steps to change the plan’s **Total Plan Budget**:

1. Locate the **Budget** section of your in-progress plan’s **6 out of 6 Steps** page.
2. Select the **Total Plan Budget** field.
3. Enter the desired impression or monetary value, depending on whether this is a budget-based or impression-based plan.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
section_path: Delete a campaign from a plan
context_header: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage a plan’s campaigns › Delete a campaign from a plan
text:
### Delete a campaign from a plan

> **Campaign deletion notice:** Campaign deletion is permanent. As a safeguard, consider duplicating a plan before deleting any campaigns from it.

You can delete campaigns from a plan one by one or in bulk. Follow these steps to delete campaigns:

1. Locate the **Campaigns** section of your in-progress plan’s **6 out of 6 Steps** page.
2. Select the checkbox(es) next to the campaigns you’d like to delete.
3. Click **Delete**.

article_title: Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan

Once your plan features a **Ready** status, you’ll need to activate it to convert it into an insertion order (IO) and campaigns. Refer to [Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12239074-generate-a-campaign-from-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan) for step-by-step instructions and more information.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › HCP Planner troubleshooting overview
text:
## HCP Planner troubleshooting overview

You’ll need to follow specific steps and meet certain requirements to successfully create a Healthcare Professional (HCP) plan in the Planner app and generate its campaigns. If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating or managing plans and campaigns, refer to these resources first:

- [Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview)
- [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan)
- [Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12239074-generate-a-campaign-from-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan)

Return to this article to address and resolve other factors that may block your ability to create or manage HCP plans.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Maximum campaign limit exceeded
text:
### Maximum campaign limit exceeded

You’ll receive an error message when your current plan-form entries will produce too many campaigns.

You likely added too many Split Strategy customizations, and/or multiple audience types, creative types, and/or device types. While this segmentation allows you to create more precise campaigns, too many selections can cause you to exceed the maximum limit of 250 campaigns.

Follow these steps to address the issue:

1. Review and adjust the plan’s **Split Strategy**. While every plan’s campaigns are segmented by **Creative Type**, **NPI Type**, and **(Data) Partner** by default; you can manage the plan’s Device Type and/or Audience Type **Split Strategy**.
2. Change your selections in the plan’s **Audience**, **Creative Types**, and/or **Device Types**, as needed.
3. Click **Refresh** following each change to help ensure the updates you apply will achieve the intended reach and scale.

If certain targeting rules are non-negotiable, consider splitting them across two plans to help ensure the maximum limit of 250 campaigns is not exceeded.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting
text:
### Next button is disabled

The **Next** button becomes enabled when all of the current page’s required fields are completed. If this option is disabled, then one or more required fields are incomplete. All required fields are marked with a red asterisk and must be completed before you can proceed to the plan’s next step.

### Plan generation failed

In certain cases, your plan will fail to generate after you select **Create Plan**. The plan will remain in **Draft** status until you successfully generate it.

Follow these steps if your plan fails to generate:

1. Confirm that you’ve correctly completed all required fields in the plan. These fields are marked with an asterisk symbol. Refer to [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan) for step-by-step instructions on completing required and optional fields.
2. Select **Create Plan** again to rule out a technical error, such as your browser timing out or your device losing internet connection.
3. Leave the plan input form page and return to try again:
   1. Click **Save As Draft**.
   2. Open the Planner app.
   3. Select the plan draft to open it.
   4. Click **Create Plan**.

Contact your IQM support representative if your proposal fails to generate after following these steps.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Plan stuck in processing status
text:
### Plan stuck in processing status

When you generate campaigns from your HCP plan, we sync them with IQM’s campaign management tools and ensure that all of your targeting rules are applied. This process typically takes approximately one hour to complete.

Contact your IQM account representative if your plan fails to finish processing after this duration.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Plan Information section › Unable to select past dates
text:
#### Unable to select past dates

You can only select a future Start Date and End Date because the HCP plan is forward-looking: You’ll use it to generate a customized media plan tailored to your campaigns’ objectives and targeting rules.

If you’d like to generate and review performance data for past campaigns instead, you can do so via the Reports app and Insights app.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Locations section
text:
#### Targetable locations limited to United States

The plan will target the United States by default. You can add more granular location-targeting rules by selecting options such as **State**, **County**, **City**, and **ZIP Code**. Non-US targeting is not currently supported for HCP plans.

#### Targetable locations limited to “OR” relationship

HCP plans apply an “OR” relationship to all location targeting selections. This means that your campaign will target a user if they’re located in any of the geographic locations you chose, as long as all other campaign targeting criteria are met.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
section_path: Unable to select preferred data partner
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Audience Method section › Unable to select preferred data partner
text:
#### Unable to select preferred data partner

A data partner’s **Reach** metric is the maximum number of unique users that you can reach by targeting the audience when no other targeting rules or campaign settings are applied. HCP plans require that a data partner’s **Reach** and **Incremental Reach** metric equal or exceed **10** before you can select them.

If the **Data Partner** section is missing from your plan, that’s because you chose only the **Existing Audience** Audience Method. You previously made your data-partner selections when you initially generated those audiences in the Audiences app.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Audience Method section
text:
#### Existing Audience - Audience is missing from list

A given audience will populate in the **Select Audience** list when two conditions are met: It matches the **Type(s)** you selected (Matched, Segmented, Geofarmed, Contextual, and/or Account Based), and it’s an NPI-based audience. The audience must also feature a **Draft**, **Processing**, or **Ready** status.

#### Unable to select preferred Audience Method in step 2

The audiences you create or add in step 2 are based on your **Audience Method** selections in step 1 of the plan-creation process. Return to the previous page and ensure your preferred **Audience Method** (Filter Audience, Upload NPI List, Account Based, Existing Audience) is selected before proceeding to step 2.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Inventory section › No Inventory Groups are shown
text:
#### No Inventory Groups are shown

You’ll need to create an inventory group in the Inventory app before you can add it to your proposal. That inventory group must also have a known Reach greater than zero.

If you haven’t created an inventory group, refer to [Inventory groups overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview) for more details, and [Create or manage an inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9616211-create-or-manage-an-inventory-group) for step-by-step instructions. HCP plans support [Open Exchange inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_64b8b6de94) and [Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_c7fa0236ff).

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Inventory section
text:
#### PMP inventory groups are missing

HCP plans support only [Open Exchange inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_64b8b6de94) and [Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_c7fa0236ff). Refer to [Create or manage an inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9616211-create-or-manage-an-inventory-group) for step-by-step instructions on creating a new inventory group.

#### Contextual inventory groups are missing

HCP plans support only [Open Exchange inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_64b8b6de94) and [Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_c7fa0236ff). Refer to [Create or manage an inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9616211-create-or-manage-an-inventory-group) for step-by-step instructions on creating a new inventory group.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › Plan creation troubleshooting › Plans page
text:
#### Actions column - Unable to download a plan

You can download plans that feature a **Draft**, **Ready**, or **Failed** status. Review [Plan statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_831c43a04f) for more information, and refer to [Download a plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan#h_3100ed9115) for step-by-step instructions.

#### Unable to edit, duplicate, or delete a plan

Note that a plan must feature:

- A **Draft**, **Ready**, or **Failed** status to be eligible for editing.
- A **Draft**, **Ready**, **Processing**, **IO Created**, or **Failed** status to be eligible for duplicating.
- A **Draft**, **Ready**, or **Failed** status to be eligible for deleting.

If the HCP plan you’d like to manage meets the status criteria, but you’re still unable to make your desired changes, check that you haven’t selected multiple plans. You can edit, duplicate, or download only one plan at a time; or delete multiple at a time.

Refer to [Plan statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_831c43a04f) for more information.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › HCP campaign generation troubleshooting
text:
### Campaign’s time zone is locked

Each campaign’s date range uses the same time zone as the one you chose when you initially created the HCP plan. You can still edit Start Dates and End Dates in an HCP plan’s draft or in the **Campaigns** section of a generated plan.

### IO creation failed

In certain cases, your campaigns may fail to generate after you select **Create IO**. This error is typically related to a technical issue. For example, your IQM login or device’s browser may have timed out.

Refresh your browser and select **Generate Again** from the **Plans** page.

### Unable to choose which campaigns to generate

We’ll generate all of your proposal’s campaigns when you select **Create IO**. To limit the campaigns we generate, you can select the checkbox next to any campaign you’d like to exclude, then click **Delete** to remove it from your HCP plan.

Note that deleted campaigns are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign
context_header: Troubleshoot a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan or campaign › HCP campaign generation troubleshooting
text:
### Unable to generate one or more campaigns

A minimum **Reach** of **10** and budget that is greater than the sum of the campaign’s Media CPM and Data CPM are required. Note that all campaigns that meet these requirements will automatically begin generating once the **Create IO** option is selected.

### Unable to change budget type (impression based, budget based)

You choose whether to create a budget-based or impression-based insertion order (IO) when you create an HCP plan. Each of the campaigns within the plan adopt the same budget type. For this reason, individual campaigns’ budget types can’t be changed once they’re processed.

article_title: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Campaign generation overview
text:
## Campaign generation overview

The plans you create in the HCP Planner app define a single, unified media plan across devices and channels to maximize the reach and impact of your healthcare campaigns. Once you choose which of the proposal’s campaigns you’d like to generate, you can easily transition from planning to execution by finishing campaign setup in the Campaigns app.

If you’d like to add or edit individual campaigns before generating campaigns from them, first refer to [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan) for step-by-step instructions.

article_title: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Generate campaigns from a plan
text:
## Generate campaigns from a plan

> **Choosing which campaigns to generate:** A minimum **Reach** of **10**, and a budget higher than the sum of the campaign’s media cost and data cost, are required. For example, a minimum campaign budget of $15 is required if the media cost is $5 and the data cost is $10. If these conditions are met, all of a plan’s campaigns will begin generating when you select **Create IO**. If desired, you can exclude individual campaigns by deleting them from the plan. Follow the steps outlined in [Create or manage a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan) to complete this step. Note that deleted campaigns are unrecoverable, and this action is permanent. As a safeguard, consider duplicating a plan before deleting any campaigns from it. Refer to[Delete a campaign from a plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238868-create-or-manage-a-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-plan#h_09a03f77ca) for more information.

Note that a plan must feature a **Ready** status for its campaigns to be eligible for generation. Refer to [Plan statuses](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/12238826-healthcare-professional-hcp-planner-overview#h_831c43a04f) for more information.

You can activate an HCP plan’s campaigns in the following ways:

- From the **Plans** page
- From within the selected plan

article_title: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
section_path: Create the IO from the Plans page
context_header: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Generate campaigns from a plan › Create the IO from the Plans page
text:
### Create the IO from the Plans page

Follow these steps to generate the plan’s campaigns from the **Plans** page of the Planner app:

1. Open the Planner app.
2. Select **HCP**.
3. Locate the desired plan on the **Plans** page.
   1. If you’ve created several plans, search by a plan element (ID, Name, Created By) or filter by status to limit which plans will display on the page.
4. Select **Create IO** in the **Actions** column next to the plan. This will open a pop-up window, which you can use to review a summary of the plan’s campaigns and confirm that you’d like to activate them.
5. Check that neither the plan’s **Start Date** or **End Date** is in the past.
   1. Update the applicable field(s) to today’s date or a future date, if necessary.
6. Click **Create IO**.

The plan’s status will change from **Ready** to **Processing** while we work on generating the campaigns, then from **Processing** to **IO Created** when the process is complete. You can view and manage generated campaigns once they reach an **IO Created** status.

Note that each generated campaign will remain as a draft until you add your creatives and choose to run them.

article_title: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
section_path: Create the IO from the Plan Details page
context_header: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Generate campaigns from a plan › Create the IO from the Plan Details page
text:
### Create the IO from the Plan Details page

Follow these steps to generate the plan’s campaigns from within the selected plan in the Planner app:

1. Select the plan’s name in the **Name** column. This will open the plan.
2. Click **Next** on each page until you reach the final **6 out of 6 steps** page.
3. Select **Create IO**.

The plan’s status will change from **Ready** to **Processing** while we work on generating the campaigns, then from **Processing** to **IO Created** when the process is complete. You can view and manage generated campaigns once they reach an **IO Created** status.

Note that each generated campaign will remain as a draft until you add your creatives and choose to run them.

article_title: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan
context_header: Generate a campaign from a Healthcare Professional (HCP) Planner plan › Manage generated campaigns
text:
## Manage generated campaigns

You’ll need to add your creative(s) to your campaigns before you can run them. You can review or manage campaigns that you generated from an HCP Planner plan in the following ways:

- From the **Plans** page of the Planner app - Shortcut to Campaigns app
- From the **Plan Details** page of the Planner app - Shortcut to Campaigns app
- From the Campaigns app

> **Save time with bulk actions:** If you plan to apply the same creative to multiple campaigns, assign it from the **Creatives** app. Simply open the app, select the checkbox next to the creative, and click **Assign To Campaign**. Search and select individual campaigns, or select the insertion order (IO) to add the creative to every campaign within that IO. Click **Assign** and return to the **Campaigns** app when you’re ready to run your campaigns.

text:
### Manage generated campaigns from the Plans page - Planner app

Follow these steps to manage generated campaigns from the **Plans** page of the Planner app:

1. Open the Planner app.
2. Select **HCP**.
3. Locate the desired plan on the **Plans** page.
   1. If you’ve created several plans, search by a plan element (ID, Name, Created By) or filter by status to limit which plans will display on the page.
4. Select **View Campaigns** in the **Actions** column next to the plan. This will redirect you to the **Insertion Order Info** page of the **Campaigns** app.
5. Select a campaign from the **Campaign Name** column to open its detail page.
6. Locate and expand the Creative section. The creative formats you chose in your HCP Planner plan are pre-selected.
7. Click **+ Select Creatives** to add a creative you’ve already uploaded to the **Creatives** app, or **+ New Creative** to add a new one.
8. The remaining sections of the campaign automatically include each of the inputs you specified in your plan. You can review and update these items or any other section of the campaign, if desired.
   1. Any changes applied to the campaign will impact the values previously forecasted in your HCP Planner plan.
9. Select **Run** to run the campaign.

## Reference associated campaigns

You can quickly reference which campaigns are associated with an HCP plan directly from the Planner app. Note that this option is available only for plans featuring an **IO Created** status.

Follow these steps to reference associated campaigns:

1. Open the Planner app.
2. Select **HCP**.
3. Locate the desired plan on the **Plans** page.
   1. If you’ve created several plans, search by a plan element (ID, Name, Created By) or filter by status to limit which plans will display on the page.
