text:
## NLD Insights report scheduling

Schedule reports to take full control of NLD Insights reporting with minimal effort. Define a list of email aliases that should receive the insights, and choose how often to generate and share the reports with those users.

article_title: Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview
context_header: Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview › NLD Insights report scheduling › Delivery frequency
text:
### Delivery frequency

You’ll define a delivery frequency when you create a scheduled report. You can edit or stop the delivery schedule at any time. Refer to [Send an NLD Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report#h_b8d0783d73) for instructions on how to schedule one-time or recurring email delivery.

| **Delivery frequency category** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **One time** | Generate and send the report only once. If you plan to schedule recurring email delivery, consider first selecting **One time** to send it immediately, then proceed with defining a recurring frequency. |
| **Daily** | Generate and send the report every day up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Weekly** | Generate and send the report every week, on the day of your choice, up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Monthly** | Generate and send the report every month, on the day of your choice, up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Custom** | Generate and send the report at a repeating daily, weekly, or monthly cadence of your choice. For example, set up a custom frequency of every two weeks. |
| **Template status - Active** | Allow the report’s delivery frequency settings to be executed until the **End Date (optional)** you specify is reached, or until you change the template’s status to **Inactive**. |
| **Template status - Inactive** | Stop the report’s delivery frequency settings from being executed until you change the template’s status back to **Active**. |

article_title: Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview
context_header: Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview › Key terms and concepts › Data aggregation
text:
### Data aggregation

When you set up recurring delivery for an NLD Insights report, you’ll have the option to enable **Data Aggregations**.

When enabled, the report is generated from the report’s start date to the last day, week, or month–depending on the delivery schedule–prior to the report’s delivery date. In other words, the data is aggregated over a rolling time frame.

When disabled, the report is generated for the period of time between the last generated report and the most recent scheduled day, week, or month–depending on the delivery schedule. For example, a weekly report with **Data Aggregations** disabled will include data from only the past week.

text:
### Generate an NLD Insights report from the Insights app

Follow these steps to generate an NLD Insights report and choose a one-time or recurring delivery schedule:

1. Open the Insights app.
2. Select **Nurse Level Data**.
3. Click **+ Create New**. This will open the **Generate and Schedule NLD** pop-up window.
4. Enter a name for this NLD template.
   1. All recurring reports will be nested under this template’s name.
5. Choose whether the campaigns are **Running**, **Paused**, or **Expired** from the **Campaign Status** menu.
6. Search and select the campaign(s) for which you want to generate insights.
7. To schedule a one-time report delivery:
   1. Choose a **One-Time** delivery frequency.
   2. Select a time frame from the **Date Range** field.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
8. To schedule a daily report delivery:
   1. Choose a **Daily** delivery frequency.
   2. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
9. To schedule a weekly report delivery:
   1. Choose a **Weekly** delivery frequency.
   2. Choose on which day of the week the weekly report should be delivered (e.g., on Mondays).
   3. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.

text:
### Generate an NLD Insights report from the Insights app

Follow these steps to generate an NLD Insights report and choose a one-time or recurring delivery schedule:

10. To schedule a monthly report delivery:
    1. Choose a **Monthly** delivery frequency.
    2. Choose on which day of the month the monthly report should be delivered (e.g., on the **First Day of Month** or on the 15th day of the month).
    3. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
       1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
11. To schedule report delivery for a custom time frame:
    1. Choose a **Custom** delivery frequency.
    2. Choose how often the report should be delivered. The following values are supported:
       1. Day(s): 1-365
       2. Week(s): 1-52
       3. Month(s): 1-12
    3. Choose on which day the custom report should be delivered (e.g., on Mondays).
    4. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
       1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
12. Enter an email alias for each report recipient, separated by commas.
13. If desired, select the **Data Aggregations** toggle to enable aggregation.
    1. The option to aggregate data is available for NLD reports with a **Daily**, **Weekly**, **Monthly**, or **Custom** delivery frequency.
    2. Refer to [Key terms and concepts: Data aggregation](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview#h_d9aef0f29d) for more details.
14. Click **Next**.
15. Review a summary of your report selections and scheduling settings.
16. Select **Generate** (one-time delivery frequency) or **Schedule** (recurring delivery frequency)
    1. The **NLD Insights Cost** will be deducted from your account’s available balance as soon as the report generates.

Once generated, you can find the NLD Insights report on the Insights app’s **Nurse Level Data** page. Review Manage an NLD Insights report for details on how to review, download, send, or delete a report.

The **Nurse Level Data** page displays each of your NLD Insights report templates and their statuses. You can use the **Actions** column to manage your existing NLD Insights report templates and their delivery schedules; or the **Reports** column to review, download, and send generated reports.

text:
### Download an NLD Insights report

Follow these steps to download a generated NLD Insights report:

1. Select the number of generated reports in the **Reports** column. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template.
2. Click **Download** from the desired generated report’s **Actions** column.
3. Choose whether you’d like to download the report as a CSV or XLSX file.
4. Select **Done** to close the **Reports** pop-up window and return to the **Nurse Level Data** page.

You’ll receive your insights as a single CSV or XLSX file if the spreadsheet contains 100K or less rows. Otherwise, you’ll receive them as a ZIP file containing multiple files. For example, if the report contains a total of 150K rows and you choose to download the insights as an XLSX file, then your download will include one ZIP file containing two XLSX files: one with 100K rows and one with 50K rows.

### Review past NLD Insights report spend from the Reports app

Follow these steps to review the total amount spent on NLD Insights report generation from the Reports app:

1. Open the Reports app.
2. Click **+ Create Report**. This will open the **Create New Report** page.
3. Locate and expand the **Spending** category.
4. Drag the **NLD Insights Cost** metric into the **Columns** field.
5. Complete any other required or optional fields, as needed.
6. Select **Execute Report**.
7. Click **Save Report**.

Workspace admins also have the option to add the **Workspace NLD Insights Earnings** metric under the **Earnings** category to a report.

Refer to [Generate, manage, or send a report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10343879-generate-manage-or-send-a-report) for additional support related to creating a new report.

text:
## NLD Insights report troubleshooting overview

Advertisers can create Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights reports if their account and campaigns meet certain eligibility criteria. They must also follow specific steps to successfully generate a report.

If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating or managing an NLD Insights report, refer to these resources first:

- [Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview)
- [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report)

Return to this article to address and resolve other factors that may block your ability to create or manage NLD Insights reports.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report
context_header: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report › NLD Insights report creation troubleshooting
text:
### Cannot locate Insights app

Your IQM homepage includes all apps that your Workspace administrator has enabled you to access. Contact yours to request the appropriate permissions to access the Insights app, if applicable.

### Insufficient funds

The workflow to generate an NLD Insights report ends with a **Generate** button. If your account’s available balance is less than the price of the NLD Insights report, this button will prompt you to add funds to the account instead.

For scheduled reports, the report will fail to generate if the account has insufficient funds during the report-generation attempt.

Refer to the steps outlined in [Add and manage funds](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5734663-add-and-manage-funds) to add funds from the Organization app, or contact your organization administrator to complete this process.

context_header: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report › NLD Insights report creation troubleshooting › Campaign is missing from list
text:
### Campaign is missing from list

A campaign is typically excluded from the **Campaign** list due to its [eligibility](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview#h_16b5936a23) or [status](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview#h_8ddc40d0bf), or the total number of selected campaigns.

- **Eligibility:** In the Insights app, the **Campaign** list only includes campaigns that are eligible for NLD report creation. Likewise, in the Campaigns and Dashboard apps, the option to generate an NLD report is only available for eligible campaigns. Refer to [Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125106-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report-overview) for more information on the factors that make your account and campaign eligible for NLD Insights report generation.
- **Status:** You can generate NLD Insights reports for eligible campaigns featuring a **Pending**, **Running**, or **Expired** status. When you generate a report from the Insights app, you’ll select the campaign’s current status before opening the **Campaign** list. This selection narrows the available campaign options. For example, when **Expired** is selected, the **Campaign** list will only include eligible campaigns featuring an **Expired** status.
- **Total number of selected campaigns:** Up to 50 campaigns can be selected per NLD Insights report.

To help reduce errors next time, consider generating an NLD Insights report from the Campaigns or Dashboards apps. Unlike in the Insights app, these two workflows will pre-populate the **Campaign Status**, **Campaign**, and Date Range fields during setup.

Refer to [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report) for more information on how to generate an NLD Insights report from the Campaigns or Dashboard apps.

context_header: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report › NLD Insights report creation troubleshooting › Cannot generate a report
text:
### Cannot generate a report

You may encounter a warning message or another issue that blocks you from generating NLD Insights data from a particular campaign and across a particular date range. We build in certain blocks to help avoid charging you for highly similar datasets more than once, or generating reports inaccurately.

These blocks typically occur for one of the following reasons:

- **You can generate one NLD Insights report at a time for each campaign**. You can generate another NLD Insights report once your in-progress report displays a **Ready** status on the **Nurse Level Data** page. Refer to [Generate or manage a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report) to learn how to access this page.
- **You can’t generate an identical NLD Insights report.** If you attempt to report on the same campaign(s) and dates of an existing report, the **Generate** option won’t be available in the **Generate Nurse Level Data** widget. Instead, you can review the NLD Insights report that you already generated for this campaign and the selected date range.

There may be certain cases where you’ve previously generated NLD Insights reports, but your access is now revoked. For example, your signed MSA for NLD Insights reporting may have expired. You won’t be able to generate new insights, but you can continue to access reports you’ve already generated for up to one year after their creation date.

text:
### Date Range field is disabled

The **Date Range** field automatically becomes enabled after one or more campaigns is selected from the **Campaign** list.

### Cannot select my preferred date range

An NLD Insights report’s dates must meet these criteria:

- You can select date ranges of up to 365 days.
- The dates you select must have taken place during the campaign’s date range, and it must have served impressions on each of those dates.

Consider generating multiple NLD Insights reports for the same campaign if its duration exceeds 365 days.

### Cannot select my preferred delivery schedule

You can choose to generate the NLD Insights report one time, daily, weekly, or monthly.

If you’d prefer to enter a custom delivery frequency, select **Custom** from the **Delivery Frequency** menu, and enter how often the report should be delivered. The following values are supported:

- Day(s): 1-365
- Week(s): 1-52
- Month(s): 1-12

text:
### Template Status toggle switch is disabled

You can manage an NLD Insights report template’s delivery schedule status (**Active**, **Inactive**) when the selected **Delivery Frequency** is Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Custom.

Since reports with a One Time frequency are only generated once, the option to make it **Active** or **Inactive** isn’t available. Update the report template’s **Delivery Frequency** to enable the toggle switch.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report
context_header: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report › NLD Insights report results troubleshooting
text:
### Cannot delete a report

We limit the ability to delete NLD Insights reports to help avoid accidental deletions of paid insights.

The **Nurse Level Data** page of the Insights app displays each of your NLD Insights reports and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. You can delete any **Failed** reports either individually or in bulk.

### Cannot email a report

The email feature is disabled when the report’s status is **Processing** or **Failed**.

The **Nurse Level Data** page of the Insights app displays each of your NLD Insights reports and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. You can email any **Ready** reports.

article_title: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report
context_header: Troubleshoot a Nurse Level Data (NLD) Insights report › NLD Insights report results troubleshooting
text:
### Email includes a link rather than the report file

The email includes a link to the report rather than a file attachment when the report’s file size is greater than 25 MB. This limitation is to comply with the file-size restrictions of most email inboxes.

### Cannot locate a generated report

One-time and recurring generated reports are nested within the NLD report template that you created.

To review a generated report, select the number in the **Reports** column for the desired report template. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template, where you can review, download, and email each of your generated reports.

Refer to [Manage an NLD Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125174-generate-or-manage-a-nurse-level-data-nld-insights-report#h_0ba87a582a) for step-by-step instructions.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report overview
text:
## ICT Insights report overview

Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report uncover key details about the [ICT audiences](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview) you’ve targeted in previous and current campaigns. They uncover ad-exposure, engagement, demographic, and physician-specialty data to reveal reach and impact.

ICT audiences broaden reach beyond your NPI lists to include relevant care-team cohorts that share similar characteristics, and without requiring manual creation for those individual audiences. Reporting on these audiences with ICT Insights helps you validate whether your campaigns are connecting with the right healthcare professionals across channels.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report eligibility requirements
text:
## ICT Insights report eligibility requirements

Certain healthcare advertisers are eligible to generate ICT Insights reports. The following conditions must also be met prior to ICT Insights report generation.

| **Requirement** | **Requirement details** |
| --- | --- |
| **Campaign vertical*** | Healthcare |
| **Campaign type** | Advanced |
| **Campaign status** | Running Expired (within the past 2 years) Paused |
| **Campaign duration** | At least 7 days through yesterday’s date |
| **Campaign limit** | Up to 50 eligible campaigns from the same insertion order (IO) per report |
| **Audience type** | Campaign must target at least one [Integrated Care Team (ICT)](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13943736-integrated-care-team-ict-audience-overview) input-type (HCP, Nurse) audience |

***Healthcare:** Any campaign created under a healthcare advertiser account is a “Healthcare” campaign.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report pricing
text:
## ICT Insights report pricing

There is a cost associated with generating an ICT Insights report. You can reference its price after you enter key details–like the source campaigns and their date ranges–and before you generate the report. We calculate the report’s chargeable impressions on a CPM basis. These chargeable impressions include impressions generated from both the input-type audience (HCP, Nurse) and impressions generated from Extension audience(s) (HCP, Nurse, Non-NPI Nurse).

Refer to [Generate or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14126938-generate-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report) for more information on where to reference the report-price preview.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report pricing
text:
### Price deduction - Sufficient funds

The **ICT Insights Cost** is deducted from your account’s available balance when a one-time report successfully generates, and each time a scheduled report successfully generates.

Refer to [Generate or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14126938-generate-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report) for step-by-step instructions on creating a new report and setting up or managing a delivery schedule.

### Price deduction - Insufficient funds

> **Funds notice:** Organization administrators can add funds to an account. Contact yours to complete this process.

The **ICT Insights Cost** is deducted from your account’s available balance when a one-time report successfully generates, and each time a scheduled report successfully generates. However, there may be instances when your account’s available funds are too low to cover the report’s ICT Insights Cost.

When you create a new report, you can click **Add Funds** directly from the report creation workflow to select a payment method and enter the desired amount you’d like to add.

When you schedule a recurring report and there are insufficient funds, the report’s generation will automatically fail. Specific users will be notified of the generation failure via email, and you’ll have an opportunity to add funds from your report template and regenerate the report.

Refer to [Generate or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14126938-generate-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report) for step-by-step instructions on managing failed reports and adding funds.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
section_path: Pricing for ICT Insights reports with overlapping datasets
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report pricing › Pricing for ICT Insights reports with overlapping datasets
text:
### Pricing for ICT Insights reports with overlapping datasets

There may be instances when you generate multiple ICT Insights reports with partially overlapping date ranges for the same campaign. You may also choose to aggregate data for recurring scheduled reports. This means that the insight data also overlaps. You’ll pay only once for ICT Insights—you won’t be charged again for the same combination of impressions and dates.

**Example:** You generate two reports for the same campaign—one with a date range of August 1st-10th, and another with a date range of August 5th-20th. Since you already paid for the insights from August 1st-10th, we’ll only change you for a portion of the second report: the new data generated for the August 11th-20th date range. We’ll still aggregate data from the full August 5th-20th date range in the second report.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report metrics
text:
## ICT Insights report metrics

ICT Insights reports return ad exposure and demographic metrics at the user level. If you used NPI data for audience creation, you can also reference each user’s National Provider Identifier (NPI) ID.

ICT Insights report metrics may be spread across multiple tabs based on the included input-type audience (HCP, Nurse) and Extension audience(s) (HCP, Nurse, Non-NPI Nurse).

| **Tab(s)** | **Metric title** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All | **Impressions** | The number of times the user viewed your ad. |
| All | **Clicks** | The number of times the user clicked on your ad. |
| All | **Conversions** | The number of a user’s conversions that can be attributed to your ad. |
| All | **Completes** | The number of times that the video creative played for its entire duration. |
| Input-type (HCP, Nurse), Extension (Nurse) | **NPI ID*** | The 10-digit numeric identifier devoid of intelligence that’s used to correlate covered healthcare providers with their respective digital identities. |
| Input-type (Nurse), Extension (Nurse) | **Nurse NPI ID*** | The 10-digit numeric identifier devoid of intelligence that’s used to correlate covered healthcare providers with their respective digital identities. |
| Extension (Non-NPI Nurse) | **State License ID** | The unique, government-issued identifier verifying that a professional is licensed to practice healthcare in a specific state. |
| All | **First Name** | The user’s legal first name. |
| All | **Last Name** | The user’s legal last name. |
| Input-type (HCP, Nurse), Extension (Nurse) | **Specialty Group** | The primary medical specialty for which the user is licensed. |
| Input-type (Nurse), Extension (Nurse, Non-NPI Nurse) | **Specialty** | The general care or primary medical specialization for which the nurse is licensed. |
| Input-type (HCP, Nurse), Extension (Nurse) | **Primary Specialty** | The branch of patients, diseases, or skills that the user evaluates, diagnoses, or manages at medical practice. |
| Input-type (HCP, Nurse), Extension (Nurse) | **Secondary Specialty** | The subspecialty that the user evaluates, diagnoses, or manages at a medical practice (e.g., Primary Specialty: Anesthesiology, Secondary Specialty: Pediatric Anesthesiology). |

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report metrics
text:
## ICT Insights report metrics

ICT Insights report metrics may be spread across multiple tabs based on the included input-type audience (HCP, Nurse) and Extension audience(s) (HCP, Nurse, Non-NPI Nurse).

| **Tab(s)** | **Metric title** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All | **ZIP Code** | The user’s permanent residence location details. |
| Input-type (HCP, Nurse), Extension (Nurse) | **Age Group** | The lower and upper ages that the user’s age falls into. |
| Input-type (HCP, Nurse), Extension (Nurse) | **Gender** | The user’s legal sex. |
| All | **Geo Lat** | The latitudinal coordinates of the device that the ad was served on. |
| All | **Geo Lon** | The longitudinal coordinates of the device that the ad was served on. |
| Extension (Non-NPI Nurse) | **State** | The state where the user’s device was located when the ad was served. |
| All | **IP Address** | The IP address that the device was connected to when the ad was served. |
| All | **DMA** | The Designated Market Area (DMA) that the campaign targeted, which is a region of the United States that Nielsen defined to measure local television viewership. |
| All | **Exchange** | The tech platform that made the buying and selling of ad inventory across ad networks possible. |
| All | **Advertiser** | The advertiser account that created the campaign. |
| All | **Browser** | The web browser that the ad was served on. |
| All | **Campaign ID** | The campaign’s unique identifier. |
| All | **Campaign** | The campaign’s name. |
| All | **Creative Type** | The format of the ad creative (image, HTML, video, audio, or native). |
| All | **Creative ID** | The served creative’s unique identifier. |
| All | **Creative Size** | The dimensions of the ad. |
| All | **Creative Name** | The served creative’s name. |
| All | **Device Type** | The category of device (TV, tablet, desktop, or mobile) that the ad was served on. |
| All | **Device Manufacturer** | The company that created the device that the ad was served on. |
| All | **Device OS** | The Operating System (OS) that the user was connected to when they were served the ad. |
| All | **IAB Category** | The IAB Tech Lab page-content category that the campaign targeted. |
| All | **Carrier Name** | The company that provided the cellular data necessary for the ad to serve over SMS, phone calls, or internet access. |

***NPI ID:** The NPI is a component of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and serves as a unique identification number for covered healthcare providers.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report statuses
text:
## ICT Insights report statuses

You can review a ICT Insights report’s current status on the **Integrated Care Team** page.

| **Status** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| **Ready** | Your insights are generated. You can view, download, or email the ICT report. |
| **Processing** | We’re working on generating your insights. Check back in about 15 minutes. |
| **Failed* - with an “X” icon** | You either encountered a technical error during report generation, or the campaign you selected is no longer eligible for ICT Insights reporting. Try again in a few minutes to rule out a technical error. |
| **Failed* - with a “$” icon** | You scheduled a report, but it couldn’t be generated because your account had insufficient funds. Refer to Price deduction - Insufficient funds for more information. |

* If an ICT Insights report features a **Failed** status, no **ICT Insights Cost** will be deducted from the advertiser’s balance.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report scheduling
text:
## ICT Insights report scheduling

Schedule reports to take full control of ICT Insights reporting with minimal effort. Define a list of email aliases that should receive the insights, and choose how often to generate and share the reports with those users.

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › ICT Insights report scheduling › Delivery frequency
text:
### Delivery frequency

You’ll define a delivery frequency when you create a scheduled report. You can edit or stop the delivery schedule at any time. Refer to [Send an ICT Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14126938-generate-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report#h_5ee380cc17) for instructions on how to schedule one-time or recurring email delivery.

| **Delivery frequency category** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **One time** | Generate and send the report only once. If you plan to schedule recurring email delivery, consider first selecting **One time** to send it immediately, then proceed with defining a recurring frequency. |
| **Daily** | Generate and send the report every day up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Weekly** | Generate and send the report every week, on the day of your choice, up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Monthly** | Generate and send the report every month, on the day of your choice, up until the **End Date (optional)** you specify. |
| **Custom** | Generate and send the report at a repeating daily, weekly, or monthly cadence of your choice. For example, set up a custom frequency of every two weeks. |
| **Template status - Active** | Allow the report’s delivery frequency settings to be executed until the **End Date (optional)** you specify is reached, or until you change the template’s status to **Inactive**. |
| **Template status - Inactive** | Stop the report’s delivery frequency settings from being executed until you change the template’s status back to **Active**. |

article_title: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview
context_header: Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview › Key terms and concepts › Data aggregation
text:
### Data aggregation

When you set up recurring delivery for an ICT Insights report, you’ll have the option to enable **Data Aggregations**.

When enabled, the report is generated from the report’s start date to the last day, week, or month–depending on the delivery schedule–prior to the report’s delivery date. In other words, the data is aggregated over a rolling time frame.

When disabled, the report is generated for the period of time between the last generated report and the most recent scheduled day, week, or month–depending on the delivery schedule. For example, a weekly report with **Data Aggregations** disabled will include data from only the past week.

ICT audiences expand reach beyond NPI lists to include relevant care-team cohorts, eliminating the need for manual audience creation. Reporting on these audiences helps validate campaign effectiveness in reaching the right healthcare professionals across channels.

You can generate an ICT Insights report if your campaigns and account meet certain criteria. Refer to [Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125991-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report-overview) for more information.

context_header: Generate or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report › Generate a one-time or recurring ICT Insights report › Generate an ICT Insights report from the Insights app
text:
### Generate an ICT Insights report from the Insights app

Follow these steps to generate an ICT Insights report and choose a one-time or recurring delivery schedule:

1. Open the Insights app.
2. Select **Integrated Care Team**.
3. Click **+ Create New**. This will open the **Generate and Schedule ICT** pop-up window.
4. Enter a name for this ICT template.
   1. All recurring reports will be nested under this template’s name.
5. Choose whether the campaigns are **Running**, **Paused**, or **Expired** from the **Campaign Status** menu.
6. Search and select the campaign(s) for which you want to generate insights.
7. To schedule a one-time report delivery:
   1. Choose a **One-Time** delivery frequency.
   2. Select a time frame from the **Date Range** field.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
8. To schedule a daily report delivery:
   1. Choose a **Daily** delivery frequency.
   2. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
9. To schedule a weekly report delivery:
   1. Choose a **Weekly** delivery frequency.
   2. Choose on which day of the week the weekly report should be delivered (e.g., on Mondays).
   3. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
      1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.

text:
### Generate an ICT Insights report from the Insights app

Follow these steps to generate an ICT Insights report and choose a one-time or recurring delivery schedule:

10. To schedule a monthly report delivery:
    1. Choose a **Monthly** delivery frequency.
    2. Choose on which day of the month the monthly report should be delivered (e.g., on the **First Day of Month** or on the 15th day of the month).
    3. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
       1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
11. To schedule report delivery for a custom time frame:
    1. Choose a **Custom** delivery frequency.
    2. Choose how often the report should be delivered. The following values are supported:
       1. Day(s): 1-365
       2. Week(s): 1-52
       3. Month(s): 1-12
    3. Choose on which day the custom report should be delivered (e.g., on Mondays).
    4. Select a time frame from the **Start date** and, if desired, **End date** fields.
       1. The first day of the campaign, up through two days ago, can be selected.
12. Enter an email alias for each report recipient, separated by commas.
13. If desired, select the **Data Aggregations** toggle to enable aggregation.
    1. The option to aggregate data is available for ICT reports with a **Daily**, **Weekly**, **Monthly**, or **Custom** delivery frequency.
    2. Refer to [Key terms and concepts: Data aggregation](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125991-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report-overview#h_83f2bd5c6e) for more details.
14. Click Next.
15. Review a summary of your report selections and scheduling settings.
16. Select **Generate** (one-time delivery frequency) or **Schedule** (recurring delivery frequency)
    1. The **ICT Insights Cost** will be deducted from your account’s available balance as soon as the report generates.

Once generated, you can find the ICT Insights report on the Insights app’s **Integrated Care Team** page. Review Manage an ICT Insights report for details on how to review, download, send, or delete a report.

The **Integrated Care Team** page displays each of your ICT Insights report templates and their statuses. text:
### Download an ICT Insights report

Follow these steps to download a generated ICT Insights report:

1. Select the number of generated reports in the **Reports** column. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template.
2. Click **Download** from the desired generated report’s **Actions** column.
3. Choose whether you’d like to download the report as a CSV or XLSX file.
4. Select **Done** to close the **Reports** pop-up window and return to the **Integrated Care Team** page.

You’ll receive your insights as a single CSV or XLSX file if the spreadsheet contains 100K or less rows. Otherwise, you’ll receive them as a ZIP file containing multiple files. For example, if the report contains a total of 150K rows and you choose to download the insights as an XLSX file, then your download will include one ZIP file containing two XLSX files: one with 100K rows and one with 50K rows.

### Email a generated ICT Insights report

Follow these steps to email a generated ICT Insights report to yourself and other recipients:

1. Select the number of generated reports in the **Reports** column. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template.

### Stop a recurring report delivery schedule

2. In the **Delivery Details** section, select the **Template status** toggle switch to change the status from **Active** to **Inactive**.

2. In the **Delivery Details** section, select the **Template status** toggle switch to change the status from **Inactive** to **Active**.
3. Click **Next**.
4. Review a summary and apply your changes.

The template’s status will remain active until you pause the report delivery schedule.

context_header: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report › ICT Insights report troubleshooting overview
text:
## ICT Insights report troubleshooting overview

Advertisers can create Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights reports if their account and campaigns meet certain eligibility criteria. They must also follow specific steps to successfully generate a report.

If you encounter an error or are blocked from creating or managing an ICT Insights report, refer to these resources first:

- [Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125991-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report-overview)
- [Generate or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14126938-generate-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report)

Return to this article to address and resolve other factors that may block your ability to create or manage ICT Insights reports.

article_title: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report
context_header: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report › ICT Insights report creation troubleshooting
text:
### Cannot locate Insights app

Your IQM homepage includes all apps that your Workspace administrator has enabled you to access. Contact yours to request the appropriate permissions to access the Insights app, if applicable.

### Insufficient funds

The workflow to generate an ICT Insights report ends with a **Generate** button. If your account’s available balance is less than the price of the ICT Insights report, this button will prompt you to add funds to the account instead.

For scheduled reports, the report will fail to generate if the account has insufficient funds during the report-generation attempt.

Refer to the steps outlined in [Add and manage funds](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5734663-add-and-manage-funds) to add funds from the Organization app, or contact your organization administrator to complete this process.

article_title: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report
context_header: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report › ICT Insights report creation troubleshooting › Campaign is missing from list
text:
### Campaign is missing from list

A campaign is typically excluded from the **Campaign** list due to its [eligibility](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125991-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report-overview#h_f1838a4599) or [status](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125991-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report-overview#h_186b729b29), or the total number of selected campaigns.

- **Eligibility:** In the Insights app, the **Campaign** list only includes campaigns that are eligible for ICT report creation. Likewise, in the Campaigns and Dashboard apps, the option to generate an ICT report is only available for eligible campaigns. Refer to [Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14125991-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report-overview) for more information on the factors that make your account and campaign eligible for ICT Insights report generation.
- **Status:** You can generate ICT Insights reports for eligible campaigns featuring a **Pending**, **Running**, or **Expired** status. When you generate a report from the Insights app, you’ll select the campaign’s current status before opening the **Campaign** list. This selection narrows the available campaign options. For example, when **Expired** is selected, the **Campaign** list will only include eligible campaigns featuring an **Expired** status.
- **Total number of selected campaigns:** Up to 50 campaigns can be selected per ICT Insights report.

To help reduce errors next time, consider generating an ICT Insights report from the Campaigns or Dashboards apps. Unlike in the Insights app, these two workflows will pre-populate the **Campaign Status**, **Campaign**, and Date Range fields during setup.

Refer to [Generate or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14126938-generate-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report) for more information on how to generate an ICT Insights report from the Campaigns or Dashboard apps.

article_title: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report
context_header: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report › ICT Insights report creation troubleshooting › Cannot generate a report
text:
### Cannot generate a report

You may encounter a warning message or another issue that blocks you from generating ICT Insights data from a particular campaign and across a particular date range. We build in certain blocks to help avoid charging you for highly similar datasets more than once, or generating reports inaccurately.

These blocks typically occur for one of the following reasons:

- **You can generate one ICT Insights report at a time for each campaign**. You can generate another ICT Insights report once your in-progress report displays a **Ready** status on the **Integrated Care Team** page. Refer to [Generate or manage an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14126938-generate-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report) to learn how to access this page.
- **You can’t generate an identical ICT Insights report.** If you attempt to report on the same campaign(s) and dates of an existing report, the **Generate** option won’t be available in the **Generate and schedule ICT** widget. Instead, you can review the ICT Insights report that you already generated for this campaign and the selected date range.

There may be certain cases where you’ve previously generated ICT Insights reports, but your access is now revoked. For example, your signed MSA for ICT Insights reporting may have expired. You won’t be able to generate new insights, but you can continue to access reports you’ve already generated for up to one year after their creation date.

article_title: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report
context_header: Troubleshoot an Integrated Care Team (ICT) Insights report › ICT Insights report creation troubleshooting
text:
### Date Range field is disabled

The **Date Range** field automatically becomes enabled after one or more campaigns is selected from the **Campaign** list.

### Cannot select my preferred date range

An ICT Insights report’s dates must meet these criteria:

- You can select date ranges of up to 365 days.
- The dates you select must have taken place during the campaign’s date range, and it must have served impressions on each of those dates.

Consider generating multiple ICT Insights reports for the same campaign if its duration exceeds 365 days.

### Cannot select my preferred delivery schedule

You can choose to generate the ICT Insights report one time, daily, weekly, or monthly.

If you’d prefer to enter a custom delivery frequency, select **Custom** from the **Delivery Frequency** menu, and enter how often the report should be delivered. The following values are supported:

- Day(s): 1-365
- Week(s): 1-52
- Month(s): 1-12

### Template Status toggle switch is disabled

You can manage an ICT Insights report template’s delivery schedule status (**Active**, **Inactive**) when the selected **Delivery Frequency** is Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Custom.

Since reports with a One Time frequency are only generated once, the option to make it **Active** or **Inactive** isn’t available. Update the report template’s **Delivery Frequency** to enable the toggle switch.

text:

We limit the ability to delete ICT Insights reports to help avoid accidental deletions of paid insights.

The **Integrated Care Team** page of the Insights app displays each of your ICT Insights reports and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. You can delete any **Failed** reports either individually or in bulk.

The **Integrated Care Team** page of the Insights app displays each of your ICT Insights reports and their statuses: **Ready**, **Processing**, and **Failed**. You can email any **Ready** reports.

The email includes a link to the report rather than a file attachment when the report’s file size is greater than 25 MB. This limitation is to comply with the file-size restrictions of most email inboxes.

One-time and recurring generated reports are nested within the ICT report template that you created.

To review a generated report, select the number in the **Reports** column for the desired report template. This will open the **Reports** pop-up window for that template, where you can review, download, and email each of your generated reports.

Refer to [Manage an ICT Insights report](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/14126938-generate-or-manage-an-integrated-care-team-ict-insights-report#h_666a67c685) for step-by-step instructions.

context_header: Political Planner overview › Political Planner overview
text:
## Political Planner overview

Political Planner is a specialized, AI-driven tool designed to streamline the complex process of political media planning and forecasting.

By integrating [Custom Voter audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13336712-custom-voter-audience-overview) data with conversational AI, you can use Political Planner to generate tailored strategies and unique reach estimates even when initial campaign details are limited. You’ll have the opportunity to experiment and compare multiple budget and input scenarios to activate the strategies that align with your political campaign goals.

With Political Planner, you can pre-optimize your audience and targeting details to help ensure each campaign spends in full—all without allocating resources to test-and-learn budgets. This includes segmenting the plan’s campaigns by elements such as Location, Audience, Device Type, Inventory Groups, and Creative Types; and determining budgets and targeting criteria for each campaign.

The plans you create will automatically sync with campaign management tools. This means you can easily transition from planning to execution. Simply activate the plan, add your creatives, and launch your pre-optimized political campaigns.

section_path: Political Planner eligibility requirements and pricing
context_header: Political Planner overview › Political Planner eligibility requirements and pricing
text:
## Political Planner eligibility requirements and pricing

All political advertisers are eligible to generate Political Planner plans at no additional cost.

Note that there’s a cost associated with the third-party data segments that you select while building the plan. However, their CPMs only apply when you convert the plan into an insertion order (IO) and campaigns, and those campaigns begin serving impressions against those segments.

You can locate a data segment’s CPM in the plan’s **3rd Party Data Segments** section. Refer to [Create or manage a Political Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/15265999-create-or-manage-a-political-planner-plan) to get started, or continue reading for more information about Political Planner.

context_header: Political Planner overview › Plan inputs
text:
## Plan inputs

You’ll define the name, dates, and creative type(s) for each plan. You can also apply targeting parameters, if desired, across five optional categories.

Define a set of required items for each plan, and apply targeting parameters across three optional categories, if desired.

| **Section** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Plan Information** | Required | Specify the plan’s name and time zone, share what information you’re bringing to the plan and what information you’d like to explore, and choose up to three Audience Methods for adding your target audience to the plan. |
| **Basic Details** | Required | Define the plan’s dates, budget, and daily frequency cap. |
| **Creatives** | Required | Confirm whether the plan’s campaigns will target image, HTML, video, and/or audio creatives. At least one creative format selection is required per plan. |
| **Audience** | Required | The plan automatically populates this section based on the audience selections you applied in step two of plan creation. |
| **Location** | Optional | Choose one or more states, Designated Market Areas (DMA), counties, cities, or ZIP codes; or congressional districts, state senates, or state houses. |
| **Demographics** | Optional | Select the plan’s target age group(s), gender(s), income range(s), and/or ethnicities. Party affiliation selections are also available for applicable plans with a Voter TV+ objective. |
| **Devices** | Optional | Select one or more device types (TV, tablet, desktop, mobile) and/or one or more channels (app, web, connected TV [CTV], over-the-top [OTT]). |
| **Inventory** | Optional | Choose Open Exchange inventory, or choose or an existing [Open Exchange inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_64b8b6de94) or [Connected TV (CTV) inventory group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/9615716-inventory-groups-overview#h_c7fa0236ff) that you previously created in the Inventory app. If you select the **Open Exchange** option, you can add Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) categories and/or specific exchanges. |
| **Pre-bid Audience** | Optional | Add individual [DoubleVerify (DV) pre-bid segments](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/10874803-doubleverify-dv-pre-bid-segments) to the plan’s targeting rules. |
| **Advanced** | Optional | Either manually segment the plan’s campaigns by the targeting dimensions of your choice (Location, Audience, Device Types, Inventory) or let AI automatically segment the plan’s campaigns by these dimensions. |

context_header: Political Planner overview › Plan outputs › Strategies
text:
### Strategies

After you enter the plan’s inputs and choose to generate the plan, you’ll be presented with up to five strategies. These strategies are segmented by their overall goals: maximum reach, maximum spend and impressions, or a balanced approach.

You also have the option to create custom strategies from scratch or based on a system-generated strategy.

| **Strategy element** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **Duration** | The date range during which the proposal’s campaigns can serve ad impressions. |
| **Campaigns** | The number of campaigns included in the strategy. |
| **Budget** | The estimated total dollar amount or impression amount the strategy’s campaigns can spend. |
| **Reach** | The estimated number of individual users who can be exposed to an ad while the strategy’s campaigns are active and have remaining available budget. |
| **Impressions** | The estimated number of times the ad will be served to the strategy’s target audience. |
| **CPM** | The blended media and data cost associated with serving ad impressions. |
| **Frequency** | The maximum number of times the same user should be served an ad per day. |
| **Creatives** | The creative format(s) that the strategy’s campaigns will target. |
| **Devices** | The device(s) that the strategy’s campaigns will target. |
| **Channel** | The channel(s) that the strategy’s campaigns will target. |

context_header: Political Planner overview › Plan outputs › Forecasts
text:
### Forecasts

> **Forecasting notice:** Provided forecasts represent estimates and are based on the last seven days of data across the IQM bid landscape. The bid landscape is variable based on changes in available impressions, market seasonality, and other dynamic factors.

After you choose a strategy and select **Generate Proposal**, the plan returns forecasting metrics to help you evaluate the potential performance of your campaigns before activating them. These estimates are available for the generated proposal at the proposal level and at the individual campaign level.

| **Forecast metric or graph** | **Level** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Total Reach** | Proposal level | The estimated number of individual users who can be exposed to an ad while the proposals’ campaigns are active and have remaining available budget. |
| **Total Impressions** | Proposal level | The estimated number of times the ad will be served to the target audience. |
| **Total Budget** | Proposal level | The estimated total dollar amount or impression amount the proposal’s campaigns can spend. |
| **Linear TV Reach*** | Proposal level | The estimated number of users who can be exposed to an ad via linear TV based on the plan’s inputs, which may overlap with CTV Reach.** |
| **Linear TV Impressions*** | Proposal level | The estimated number of times the ad can be served to the target audience via linear TV based on the plan’s inputs.** |
| **Linear TV Budget*** | Proposal level | The estimated total dollar amount or impression amount that can be spent via linear TV based on the plan’s inputs.** |
| **CTV Reach*** | Proposal level | The estimated number of users who can be exposed to an ad via CTV based on the plan’s inputs, which may overlap with Linear TV Reach. |
| **CTV Impressions*** | Proposal level | The estimated number of times the ad can be served to the target audience via CTV based on the plan’s inputs. |

context_header: Political Planner overview › Plan outputs › Forecasts
text:
### Forecasts

After you choose a strategy and select **Generate Proposal**, the plan returns forecasting metrics to help you evaluate the potential performance of your campaigns before activating them. These estimates are available for the generated proposal at the proposal level and at the individual campaign level.

| **Forecast metric or graph** | **Level** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **CTV Budget*** | Proposal level | The estimated total dollar amount or impression amount the proposal’s campaigns can spend via CTV based on the plan’s inputs. |
| **Proposal Start Date** | Proposal level | The date and time when the proposal’s campaigns can begin serving ad impressions. |
| **Proposal End Date** | Proposal level | The date and time when the proposal’s campaigns must stop serving ad impressions. |
| **Bid Landscape** | Proposal level | A visualization of how different bid prices (CPM) might impact the potential number of impressions that you can win. This data is segmented based on the creative formats that you select for the proposal. |
| **Device** | Proposal level | The estimated percentage of impressions that will come from each device that the proposal’s campaigns will target. |
| **Channel** | Proposal level | The estimated percentage of impressions that will come from each channel that the proposal’s campaigns will target. |
| **Campaign Name** | Campaign level | The individual campaign’s name. |
| **Start Date** | Campaign level | The date and time when the campaign can begin serving ad impressions. |
| **End Date** | Campaign level | The date and time when the campaign must stop serving ad impressions. |
| **Reach** | Campaign level | The estimated number of individual users who can be exposed to an ad while the campaign is active and has remaining available budget. |
| **Impressions** | Campaign level | The estimated number of times the campaign will serve an ad to the target audience. |
| **Frequency** | Campaign level | The maximum number of times the same user should be served an ad per day. |
| **Budget** | Campaign level | The maximum amount the campaign can spend. Note that the campaign will stop serving ad impressions if the proposal’s Total Budget is reached before the campaign’s individual budget is exhausted. |

* **Metric availability:** This forecast metric is available for applicable plans with a **Voter TV+** objective.

context_header: Political Planner overview › Plan outputs › Forecasts
text:
### Forecasts

* **Metric availability:** This forecast metric is available for applicable plans with a **Voter TV+** objective.

** **Linear TV metrics:** Linear TV data is a reference baseline that’s included to model incremental CTV reach. No Linear TV campaigns are created or activated during the media-planning process in Political Planner.

context_header: Political Planner overview › Plan statuses
text:
## Plan statuses

You can review a plan’s current status from the **Proposals** tab of the Planner app. Refer to [Create or manage a Political Planner plan](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/15265999-create-or-manage-a-political-planner-plan) for more information on how to access this page.

| **Status** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| **Draft** | The plan creation process is underway. You started building a Political Planner plan, but you haven’t selected the **Generate Proposal** option. |
| **Ready** | You selected the **Generate Proposal** option, and now the proposal is ready to be converted into campaigns. |
| **Processing** | You selected **Generate Campaigns** from a plan that featured a **Ready** status. Now we’re creating your plan’s audiences, campaigns, insertion order (IO) and other details. |
| **Converted** | The plan’s insertion order (IO) and campaigns were successfully created. Now you can manage and launch them. |
| **Failed** | You attempted to convert the plan, but we were unable to successfully create the plan’s campaigns. Refer to [Troubleshoot a Political Planner plan or campaign](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/15266007-troubleshoot-a-political-planner-plan-proposal-or-campaign) for support. |
| **Expired** | The plan’s date range passed before you were able to activate the plan. Refer to [Restore an expired proposal](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/15265999-create-or-manage-a-political-planner-plan#h_f6505b3868) to select a new date range. Note that this action may change related forecasts. |

context_header: Political Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › IQM Universe
text:
### IQM Universe

The IQM universe refers to the total targetable audience that you can reach when you use the IQM platform to buy digital ad inventory. This universe changes based on your campaign’s targeting criteria, and narrows each time you layer on additional targets and blocks. The addressable audience you’re left with after you apply this criteria is represented by your Political Planner plan’s targeted reach and impressions.

Forecasting metrics provide a sense of scale to help you determine whether you have the right strategies in place to spend your budget in full and achieve your political campaign objectives. If a plan’s scale isn’t what you were anticipating, or if potential spend is less than your actual budget, then you have the opportunity to make adjustments to your plan and its strategies before you launch a live campaign.

Adjust your targeting criteria, as needed, to reach more of the IQM universe and achieve scale for your political campaigns. If the targets you applied are nonnegotiable, consider thinking about the strategies you may need to add to your campaigns to fulfill your budget. Refer to [Review or add strategies and generate a proposal](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/15265999-create-or-manage-a-political-planner-plan#h_8786cb4679) for more information.

context_header: Political Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience Methods
text:
### Audience Methods

When you create a new Political Planner plan, you’ll choose up to three methods for adding target users to the plan’s campaigns: **Explore Custom Voter Data**, **Select Existing Audience**, and **Select 3rd Party Data Segments**.

The **Explore Custom Voter Data** method includes using in-plan features to create a new [Custom Voter audience](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13336712-custom-voter-audience-overview). Custom Voter audiences are built using voter segments, which you can customize based on locations, districts, demographics, party registration, and more.

The **Select Existing Audience** method includes choosing one or more audience types (Matched, Segmented, Retargeted, Geofarmed, Contextual, Lookalike, Campaign, Custom Voter) and selecting one or more existing audiences. These audiences are ones that you previously created in the Audiences app. Refer to the [“Audience targeting and data management” collection](https://help.iqm.com/en/collections/1387061-audience-targeting-and-data-management) for more information on each audience type and step-by-step instructions on how to create them.

Finally, the **Select 3rd Party Data Segments** method includes creating a political campaign audience by selecting individual data segments, grouping them, and defining the relationships between those data segments and segment groups.

You can choose one, two, or a combination of all three of these methods for adding audiences as you build your plan in the Political Planner tool.

context_header: Political Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Audience Methods › Audience Methods - Audience relationships
text:
#### Audience Methods - Audience relationships

Every Political Planner plan applies an “OR” relationship to each audience type and individual audience. This means that your campaign will target a user if they’re included in any of the targeted audiences, as long as all other campaign targeting criteria are met.

You can still choose between an “AND” and “OR” relationship for individual audience segments when you create each audience. Refer to the [“Audience targeting and data management” collection](https://help.iqm.com/en/collections/1387061-audience-targeting-and-data-management) for more information on each audience type and step-by-step instructions on how to create them.

context_header: Political Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Cross-screen Planning with Voter TV+
text:
### Cross-screen Planning with Voter TV+

**Voter TV+** is an objective in Political Planner that enables media planners to model the incremental reach that CTV can deliver alongside existing or projected Linear TV spend. By bringing Linear TV and CTV planning into a single workflow, planners can quantify cross-screen reach, build a data-driven case for adding CTV to their media mix, and seamlessly convert plans into activated CTV campaigns—eliminating the need for separate planning tools and manual data re-entry.

context_header: Political Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Cross-screen Planning with Voter TV+ › Voter TV+: Reach Distribution Settings
text:
#### Voter TV+: Reach Distribution Settings

When you create a plan with a **Voter TV+** objective, you’ll choose how you’d like to model the plan’s **Audience Overlap**data. Review the table below for more details.

| **Data modeling approach** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **Linear TV %** | Model projected reach using Linear TV as a reference baseline to understand the expected audience coverage from a traditional TV investment. This budget allocation percentage provides the benchmark for evaluating incremental reach opportunities with CTV. |
| **CTV %** | Model reach delivered through CTV to evaluate a digital-first strategy or compare it against Linear TV and cross-screen scenarios. This budget allocation percentage helps planners understand the impact of CTV before activation. |

context_header: Political Planner overview › Key terms and concepts › Cross-screen Planning with Voter TV+ › Voter TV+: Audience Overlap
text:
#### Voter TV+: Audience Overlap

When you create a plan with a **Voter TV+** objective, you’ll have an opportunity to review reach forecasting metrics based on the plan’s Reach Distribution Settings. Note that all **Audience Overlap** metrics are calculated against the selected voter universe. Refer to the table below for more details.

| **Audience Overlap metric** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **Total Voter Universe** | The total audience that can be reached across all channels via the IQM platform when no targeting parameters are applied. In other words, all voters in the selected district/audience. |
| **Linear TV Target Reach** | The estimated maximum number of users you could reach via linear TV based on the plan’s inputs, which may overlap with CTV Reach. This metric is based on the plan’s Location, Demographic, and/or Audience settings. |
| **CTV Target Reach** | The estimated maximum number of users you could reach via CTV based on the plan’s inputs, which may overlap with Linear TV Reach. |
| **Duplicated Reach** | The estimated number of users you could reach via both linear TV and CTV based on the plan’s inputs. |
| **CTV Incremental Reach** | The estimated number of users you could reach via CTV, but via not linear TV, based on the plan’s inputs. |

article_title: Create or manage a Political Planner plan
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Political Planner overview
text:
## Political Planner overview

Political Planner proposals provide powerful insights into your media plan’s potential reach and impressions once you layer targeting parameters onto your campaigns. You can pre-optimize your audience and targeting details to help ensure each political campaign spends in full—all without spending resources on test-and-learn budgets.

Review [Political Planner overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/15265995-political-planner-overview) to learn more, or refer to the instructions below to get started.

article_title: Create or manage a Political Planner plan
section_path: Create a plan and generate strategies
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Create a plan and generate strategies
text:
## Create a plan and generate strategies

Follow these steps to create a new Political Planner plan:

1. Open the Planner app.
2. Select **+ Create Plan**. This will redirect you to the **New Plan** page.
3. Complete the following plan sections:
   1. Plan Information - Required
   2. Custom Voter audience - Optional
   3. Basic Details - Required
   4. Locations - Optional
   5. Demographics - Optional
   6. Audience - Optional
   7. Pre-bid Audience - Optional
   8. 3rd Party Data Segments - Optional
   9. Creatives - Optional
   10. Device - Optional
   11. Inventory - Optional
   12. Advanced - Optional

Note that only certain sections are applicable and available for plans with a **Voter TV+** objective (Plan Information, Basic Details, Locations, Demographics, Audience).

article_title: Create or manage a Political Planner plan
section_path: Create a plan and generate strategies
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Create a plan and generate strategies
text:
### Plan information - Required

Follow these steps to complete the plan’s required **Plan Information** section:

1. Enter a name for the plan.
2. Choose a plan objective based on the information you’re bringing to the plan (e.g., budget or targeting rules) and what information you’d like to explore.
   1. If you selected **Reach Forecasting** as your objective, enter the total monetary budget for all of the plan’s strategies.
3. Click **Next**.

### Custom Voter audience - Optional

> **Custom Voter audience notice:** Custom Voter audiences help ensure your political campaigns reach the right users. These audiences are built using voter segments, and are customized based on locations, districts, demographics, party registration, and more. Refer to [Custom Voter audience overview](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13336712-custom-voter-audience-overview) for more information. Note that creating a new Custom Voter audience from a Political Planner plan is optional. If you’d like to skip this step, refer to Skip Custom Voter audience creation for step-by-step instructions.

You can create a Custom Voter audience directly from the plan, and in the following ways:

- Create with voter segments
- Create with AI assist

article_title: Create or manage a Political Planner plan
section_path: Create a plan and generate strategies
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Create a plan and generate strategies › Custom Voter audience - Optional
text:
#### Create with voter segments

1. Follow steps 1 through 12 of the [Create with voter segments](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13336749-create-or-manage-a-custom-voter-audience#h_7f8710f69d) workflow.
2. Click **Next**.

#### Create with AI assist

1. Follow steps 1 through 6 of the [Create with AI assist](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/13336749-create-or-manage-a-custom-voter-audience#h_45cde562d7) workflow.
2. Click **Next**.

#### Skip Custom Voter audience creation

Follow these steps to create a plan without generating a new Custom Voter audience:

1. Select **Skip & Next**. This will open the **Skip Custom Voter Audience** pop-up window.
2. Click **Skip** to confirm your selection.

text:
### Basic Details - Required

Follow these steps to complete the plan’s required **Basic Details** section:

1. Locate and expand the **Basic Details** section.
2. Choose the plan’s start and end dates.
   1. Click **Apply** to add your selection to the applicable field.
3. Select the plan’s time zone.
4. Set a daily frequency cap, which limits the maximum number of times per day the same user should see your ads.
   1. Select **–** to decrease the **Frequency** number.
   2. Select **+** to increase the **Frequency** number.
   3. Frequency settings are supported for plans with a **Reach Forecasting** or **Budget Estimation** objective.

Note that plans with a **Voter TV+** also require a **Total Plan Budget**.

text:
### Locations - Optional

Political Planner plans support location targeting within the United States. Follow these steps to add optional location targeting settings to the plan’s **Locations** section:

1. Locate and expand the **Locations** section.
2. Enter the desired location into the search field, or skip this step and browse the list of locations.
3. If desired, filter the results by location type.
4. Select the checkbox(es) next to the desired location(s).
5. Click the **Zip Codes** tab to search and select locations by ZIP code, if desired.
6. Review and manage your selections in the **Targeted Locations** panel.
   1. Expand a section to review all locations by that location type.
   2. If desired, select the toggle to move a targeted location from the plan’s Allowlist to its Blocklist.

article_title: Create or manage a Political Planner plan
section_path: Create a plan and generate strategies
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Create a plan and generate strategies
text:
### Demographics - Optional

Use the available menus to select the plan’s target age group(s), gender(s), income range(s), and/or ethnicities.

Note that party affiliation selections (**Democratic**, **Republican**, **Unknown**) are also available for applicable plans with a **Voter TV+** objective.

### Audience - Optional

The plan automatically populates the **Audiences** section with the new Custom Voter audience you created during plan setup. Follow these steps to review and, if desired, add additional audiences to plan:

1. Locate and expand the **Audience** section.
2. Select the desired audience type(s).
3. Click **Select Audience**. This will open the **Select Existing Audience** pop-up window.
4. Search or browse and select audiences that you previously created in the Audiences app.
5. Select **Submit**.
6. If desired, select the toggle to move a targeted audience from the plan’s Allowlist to its Blocklist.

article_title: Create or manage a Political Planner plan
section_path: Create a plan and generate strategies
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Create a plan and generate strategies
text:
### Pre-bid Audience - Optional

Follow these steps to add optional Pre-bid targeting to the plan’s **Pre-bid Audience** section:

1. Locate and expand the **Pre-bid Audience** section.
2. Search or browse and select the Pre-bid audiences that you previously created in the Audiences app.
3. If desired, select **+ Add Pre-bid Segments** to search and add individual pre-bid segments instead.
4. Select the trashcan icon next to any segments that you’d like to remove. Note that doing so will only remove the segment from this particular plan–not from the original Pre-bid audience.

### 3rd Party Data Segments - Optional

Follow these steps to add optional data segments to the plan’s **3rd Party Data Segments** section:

1. Locate and expand the **3rd Party Data Segments** section.
2. Enter search terms, separated by commas, to search for specific audience characteristics.
3. All selected segments will appear in the **Select segments** list, along with their reach and cost details.
   1. Note that all segments added to this [Segment Group](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/5651486-segmented-audience-overview#h_31da47f45c) are assigned an “OR” relationship.

article_title: Create or manage a Political Planner plan
section_path: Create a plan and generate strategies
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Create a plan and generate strategies › Creatives - Optional
text:
### Creatives - Optional

> **More on creatives:** You won’t need to add your creatives until after you convert a generated proposal into an insertion order (IO) and campaigns. But we recommend reviewing [Creative ad specs and requirements](https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/7019246-creative-ad-specs-and-requirements) to ensure the creative(s) you plan to target in your plan’s campaigns will render and scale as expected.

Follow these steps to add a required creative-type selection to the plan’s **Creatives** section:

1. Locate and expand the **Creatives** section.
2. Select one or more creative formats.
3. If you plan to run on connected TV (CTV) or over-the-top (OTT) devices:
   1. Select the **Video** creative format.
   2. Click the **TV Ad Buying** toggle.

If no individual selections are made, the plan will consider all creative types in the strategies it generates.

article_title: Create or manage a Political Planner plan
section_path: Create a plan and generate strategies
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Create a plan and generate strategies
text:
### Device - Optional

Follow these steps to add optional device-targeting settings to the plan’s **Device** section:

1. Locate and expand the **Device** section.
2. Select one or more device types.
3. Select one or more channels.
4. Note that the **CTV** and **OTT** channel options only become enabled when the **TV Ad Buying** toggle switch is enabled in the plan’s **Creatives** section. Refer to Creatives - Optional for more details.

### Inventory - Optional

You can choose one of the following inventory-targeting options for your plan:

- **Open Exchange:** Public inventory sources made available via real-time bidding auctions. This option includes targeting individual IAB categories and/or exchanges.
- **Inventory Groups:** The eligible Open Exchange or Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups previously created in the Inventory app. Note that Open Exchange and CTV inventory groups created purely for blocking and groups with zero or unknown Reach aren’t eligible. Private Marketplace (PMP), Programmatic Guaranteed (PG), and Contextual inventory groups also aren’t eligible at any time.

section_path: Create a plan and generate strategies
context_header: Create or manage a Political Planner plan › Create a plan and generate strategies › Inventory - Optional
text:
#### Open Exchange inventory type

Follow these steps to add optional Open Exchange inventory targeting to the plan’s **Inventory** section:

1. Locate and expand the **Inventory** section.
2. Select **Open Exchange**.
3. To target IAB categories, which are the IAB Tech Lab’s page content categories:
   1. Open the **IAB Categories** menu.
   2. Search or browse and select all desired categories, or **Select All**.
4. To target specific exchanges:
   1. Open the **Select Exchange** menu.
   2. Search or browse and select all desired exchanges, or **Select All**.

#### Inventory Groups inventory type

Follow these steps to add optional Open Exchange or Connected TV (CTV) inventory group targeting to the plan’s **Inventory** section:

1. Select **Inventory Groups**.
2. Search or browse the list of Open Exchange and Connected TV (CTV) inventory groups.
3. If desired, filter the groups by group type.
4. Review key details about each inventory group:
   1. **Icon:** A circle icon next to the group name represents that the group is an Open Exchange inventory group, while the internet-connected TV icon represents that it’s a CTV inventory group.
   2. **Creative Type:** All supported creative format types are listed next to each inventory group’s name.
   3. **Count:** The total number of ad placements (**Inventories** or **Apps**) that match the search criteria you applied when you created the inventory group.
   4. **Device Breakdown:** The breakout of devices for each inventory group.
5. Click the checkbox(es) next to the inventory group(s) you wish to target.
